bases.desc: Tooth-shard cataclysm on slate armor. Predator devastation.

bases.name: MS Frost Sentinel
bases.desc: Frozen sentinel-blue with vigilant ice crystals. Guardian frost.

bases.name: MS Frozen Inferno
bases.desc: Paradox blue cold-flame on icefire substrate. Frozen burn.

bases.name: MS Lotus Ascention
bases.desc: Sacred lotus rising in pink-gold petals. Spiritual ascent finish.

bases.name: MS Molten Sting
bases.desc: Molten metal sting with droplet flares. Liquid-flame venom.

bases.name: MS Porcelain Cipher
bases.desc: Encoded porcelain glaze with cipher-line crackles. Mystery finish.

bases.name: MS Serpent Haze Strike
bases.desc: Toxic serpent haze with venom-strike accents. Coiled deadliness.

bases.name: MS Shadow Wraith
bases.desc: Spectral wraith-black with faint shadow-duplicate shimmer. Nearly invisible.

bases.name: MS Soul Forge
bases.desc: Forged amber with soul-ember inner glow. Crafted-spirit finish.

bases.name: MS Tempest Crown
bases.desc: Storm-crown tempest blue with lightning crown veins. Sovereign storm.

bases.name: MS Thunder Mandala
bases.desc: Sacred thunder mandala in electric violet rays. Storm-spiritual finish.

bases.name: MS Toxic Labyrinth
bases.desc: Toxic neon maze on contaminated substrate. Hazmat puzzle aesthetic.

bases.name: MS Venom Eclipse
bases.desc: Eclipse venom-dark purple with corona shimmer. Total venom blackout.

bases.name: MS Venom Veil
bases.desc: Venomous veil mixing serpent green and amethyst poison.

bases.name: MS Zero Hour
bases.desc: Final-hour steel grey with last-second crisis veins. Apocalypse finish.

bases.name: MSH: Canary Coffin
bases.desc: V2 — electric blue body, lavender/pink coffin-rust reveal; finer spec gates + chroma lift.

bases.name: MSH: Magenta Widow
bases.desc: V2 — deep blue-indigo body, hot pink/crimson web flashes. Neon ice base + widow venom overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Cerulean Cobra
bases.desc: V2 — sapphire-indigo body, molten gold scale bloom. Deep blue hue rotation, no white wash.

bases.name: MSH: Lime Scorpion
bases.desc: Violet-indigo base with ember-hex copper bloom. Densest spec tiling in the set.

bases.name: MSH: Hyperpink Torii
bases.desc: V2 — sapphire-teal body, peach-gold torii lattice flare. Magenta arc → deep blue, colored reveal.

bases.name: MSH: Seafoam Piranha
bases.desc: V2 — deep blue body, electric aqua/magenta current streaks. Cerulean base replaces dead seafoam green.

bases.name: MSH: Orchid Kintsugi
bases.desc: Teal-green body, champagne-gold crack-line reveal. Orchid pulse + kintsugi rift.

bases.name: MSH: Peach Jellyshock
bases.desc: V2 — ice-blue body, burned hot pink jelly drift. Owner hue-shift proof: blue base + jellyshock overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Daffodil Bayou
bases.desc: V2 — electric indigo body, violet/pink bayou script smoke. Canary→indigo + denser bayou overlay.

bases.name: MSH: Neon Ice Rising
bases.desc: Ice-blue body, sunset orange prismwave crown on roof and quarters.

bases.name: MSHC: Tigerblood Voltage
bases.desc: Deep indigo body, amber tiger-claw flash on glancing sun. Tiger Fang Fracture overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Oxblood Seigaiha
bases.desc: Magenta → sea-green wave body with chrome crest peaks. Seigaiha Chrome overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Emerald Sharkbite
bases.desc: Seafoam → ruby-coral reveal with salt-teeth gates. Sharkbite Riptide overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Amber Panther
bases.desc: Peach → deep teal-night body, amber pearl glints catch on curve. Panther Shadow Claw overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Violet Kyoto
bases.desc: Cerulean → red-violet with gold filigree pins. Kyoto Lantern Filigree overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Acid Hornet
bases.desc: Pink → acid yellow-green swarm reveal. Hornet Swarm Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Oni Orchid Glass
bases.desc: Orchid → coral-amber demon-mosaic shadows. Oni Veil Mosaic overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Copper Jubilee
bases.desc: Daffodil → indigo-blue with warm copper voodoo-root reveal. Root Doctor Copper overlay.

bases.name: MSHC: Canary Widow Redux
bases.desc: Canary → coral-orange with ruby web flashes. Same base, +63 rotation, Widow Web Venom.

bases.name: MSHC: Rosethorn Bonsai
bases.desc: Ice blue → soft violet-rose with leaf-circuit gates. Bonsai Drift Circuit overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Canary Gris-Gris
bases.desc: Electric indigo-blue base with a soft pearlescent amethyst crystal shift. Midnight Gris-Gris overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Emerald Brocade
bases.desc: Bright jade-teal body that flashes coral-gold scales in direct sunlight. Shogun Scale Brocade overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Fuji Neon Crest
bases.desc: Icy cyan-violet base that blooms with warm bronze-pink frost peaks. Fuji Frost Crest overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Volcanic Croc
bases.desc: Deep indigo body shifting to molten lava gold plates under high angles. Croc Delta Armor overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Cherry Blossom Flux
bases.desc: Intense sky-teal body blooming cherry-blossom pink under direct solar rays. Sakura Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Waxen Voodoo
bases.desc: Cobalt-violet body with shifting pale amber candle-wax veves catching solar glare. Candle Wax Veve overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Hyperpink Threads
bases.desc: Neon violet base with golden micro-thread grid reveals that sparkle under motion. Pins & Thread overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Peach Burlap
bases.desc: Mint-teal base with shifting copper-rose hex burlap texture. Bayou Hex Burlap overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Seafoam Charm
bases.desc: Royal purple body with shifting emerald-patina charms under grazing sunlight. Swamp Charm Patina overlay.

bases.name: MSHA: Solar Moss
bases.desc: Electric magenta base that shifts to moss-green sparkles under glanced lighting. Spanish Moss Static overlay.

bases.name: MSHX: Blueprint Jackpot V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — tighter coffin gates, stronger blue-indigo landing, brighter lavender/pink flare.

bases.name: MSHX: Venom Cashmere V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 4/REBUILD — neon-ice base, blue/purple body, colored tiger-fang glints instead of white glare.

bases.name: MSHX: Glacier Pinkslip V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — Prism Tipjar-derived sapphire body with sharkbite pink/ice flare.

bases.name: MSHX: Lime Afterburner V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 5/REBUILD — deeper blue-purple landing with dense copper scorpion ember cells.

bases.name: MSHX: Miami Blacklight V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — neon-ice substrate with magenta widow-web flare baked into the reveal.

bases.name: MSHX: Royal Sunstroke V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — canary-to-indigo base with champagne/pink Kyoto pin bloom.

bases.name: MSHX: Kintsugi Ransom
bases.desc: Teal-night paint with pale-gold fracture flashes that read expensive fast. Orchid + Kintsugi Rift.

bases.name: MSHX: Coral Sharkskin V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — owner-proven blue-base direction with hot piranha current scratches.

bases.name: MSHX: Dover Jackpot V2
bases.desc: Rebuilt after owner 3/REBUILD — darker indigo Dover body with tighter violet/pink smoke-script payout.

bases.name: MSHX: Prism Tipjar
bases.desc: Sapphire-teal body tipping warm orange/pink from prismwave micro-crowns in motion. Magenta + Rising Sun Prismwave.

bases.name: Import Royalty
bases.desc: Layered razor vinyl slashes with prismatic tuner-wrap edges.

bases.name: Toxic Overdrive
bases.desc: Acid-green current pools with yellow pressure lips and black sink regions.

bases.name: Neon Underglow
bases.desc: Ground-effects cyan and magenta rising through smoked wet-look paint.

bases.name: Blacklight Garage
bases.desc: Fluorescent solvent pools and ultraviolet shop-light reflections on concrete black.

bases.name: Burnout Ember
bases.desc: Curved tire-heat tracks, underlit smoke and ember-red rubber fragments.

bases.name: Redline Rush
bases.desc: Escalating redline heat and speed rhythm without a literal gauge.

bases.name: Tunnel Vision
bases.desc: Vanishing tunnel lights stretching into yellow, cyan and white speed wedges.

bases.name: Nitro Purge
bases.desc: Electric-blue purge plumes, frost shock and white pressure cores.

bases.name: Split Underglow
bases.desc: Opposed cyan and magenta ground-light fields dividing a smoked body.

bases.name: Afterburn Chrome
bases.desc: Heat-shifted chrome with broad spectral oxidation bands and brushed fire.

specials.name: Vellum Leaf
specials.desc: Calfskin scraped, limed and stretched, still showing the follicle side.

specials.name: Iron Gall Ink
specials.desc: Oak gall and green vitriol — black going brown, and eating the page slowly.

specials.name: Gilt Edge
specials.desc: Leaf laid on the block edge and burnished, so the closed book is solid gold.

specials.name: Ribbon Marker
specials.desc: Woven silk bound into the spine, frayed at the end from a century of use.

specials.name: Foxed Page
specials.desc: Rust-coloured spots blooming through the paper wherever the damp got in.

specials.name: Woodcut Block
specials.desc: Cut against the end grain so the line can be as fine as the printer dares.

specials.name: Illuminated Capital
specials.desc: One letter given a week, gold over gesso, with a hare in the descender.

specials.name: Marbled Endpaper
specials.desc: Colour floated on size and combed, then lifted in one pull. No two ever match.

specials.name: Calf Binding
specials.desc: Full calf, blind-tooled, darkened at the joints where the hands go.

specials.name: Wax Seal
specials.desc: Poured, stamped, and cracked across the middle the moment it was opened.

specials.name: Glass Slipper
specials.desc: It fits one person and it is made of glass — both facts are the whole story.

specials.name: Spindle Gold
specials.desc: Straw in at night and gold on the bobbin by morning, at a price agreed too fast.

specials.name: Crown Jewel
specials.desc: Cut to throw light rather than to keep weight, which is a choice about being seen.

specials.name: Mirror Mirror
specials.desc: It only ever answers the question it was asked, which is the trouble with it.

specials.name: Poisoned Apple
specials.desc: One side red enough to sell it, and the seller ate the other half first.

specials.name: Royal Velvet
specials.desc: Cut pile deep enough to hold a handprint, in the purple nobody else was allowed.

specials.name: Seven-League Boot
specials.desc: Twenty-one miles a stride, and creased across the instep like any other boot.

specials.name: Tower Stone
specials.desc: Coursed rubble with one window, set higher than anybody sensible would build.

specials.name: Briar Hedge
specials.desc: A hundred years of growth in one night, and every thorn pointing outward.

specials.name: Pumpkin Coach
specials.desc: Ribbed, gilded, and on a strict schedule.

specials.name: Wolf Pelt
specials.desc: Guard hairs over a dense undercoat, banded so the grey is never one grey.

specials.name: Breadcrumb Trail
specials.desc: A plan that depended on the birds not being hungry.

specials.name: Gingerbread
specials.desc: Baked hard, iced at the seams, and structurally sounder than it looks.

specials.name: Red Hood
specials.desc: Wool, hooded, and the single most visible thing in a winter wood.

specials.name: Thorn Thicket
specials.desc: Blackthorn: the spines are modified branches, which is why they are that hard.

specials.name: Moss Stone
specials.desc: North face, always. It is the only compass in the story that works.

specials.name: Lantern Path
specials.desc: Lit one at a time, ahead of you, by somebody who left before you arrived.

specials.name: Owl Feather
specials.desc: A serrated leading edge that breaks the air up so nothing downstairs hears it.

specials.name: Fox Fur
specials.desc: Red over cream over black, in that order, on every single hair.

specials.name: Beanstalk
specials.desc: Twining left to right because that is what beans do, all the way up.

specials.name: Dragon Scale
specials.desc: Overlapping, keeled, and each one anchored deeper than it looks.

specials.name: Hoard Gold
specials.desc: Counted once, a very long time ago, and every coin missed since.

specials.name: Phoenix Ash
specials.desc: The interesting part is not the fire. It is what is still warm underneath.

specials.name: Griffin Bronze
specials.desc: Cast in two halves and pinned, with the join green where the rain sits.

specials.name: Unicorn Horn
specials.desc: A single spiral groove, always the same handedness, in something that is not ivory.

specials.name: Mermaid Scale
specials.desc: Guanine platelets stacked to a quarter wavelength, which is why they are that colour.

specials.name: Basilisk Stone
specials.desc: Whatever it looked at last is still standing there, in considerable detail.

specials.name: Kraken Ink
specials.desc: Released as a decoy shaped roughly like the animal that released it.

specials.name: Faerie Wing
specials.desc: Structural colour in a membrane two cells thick. No pigment involved at all.

specials.name: Troll Granite
specials.desc: Caught out by the sunrise, and now part of the landscape.

specials.name: Cauldron Brew
specials.desc: Double, double. It has been on since Tuesday and nobody remembers the recipe.

specials.name: Spellbook Vellum
specials.desc: Written in a hand that expected to be read aloud, and once only.

specials.name: Wishing Well
specials.desc: Nine metres of cold water and about forty years of small change.

specials.name: Moon Path
specials.desc: It points at you from wherever you stand, which is either lovely or a warning.

specials.name: Star Dust
specials.desc: Everything heavier than helium, and all of it secondhand.

specials.name: Enchanted Ice
specials.desc: It does not melt, which is the tell. Real ice is always in a hurry.

specials.name: Witch Amber
specials.desc: Something small is in it, and it has been looking out for a very long time.

specials.name: Rune Stone
specials.desc: Straight lines only — carved across the grain, by people who carved into wood first.

specials.name: Potion Glass
specials.desc: Hand-blown, unevenly walled, and stoppered with something chewed.

specials.name: Genie Brass
specials.desc: Polished on one side from rubbing, and considerably larger on the inside.

specials.name: Wet Asphalt
specials.desc: Road after rain, holding every light in the street in a thin film.

specials.name: Oil Slick
specials.desc: A film one wavelength thick on black water, and every colour in it.

specials.name: Manhole Steam
specials.desc: Vapour off a grate at 3am, lit from one side and gone by morning.

specials.name: Tyre Black
specials.desc: Moulded tread in the deadest black there is, with the mould line still on it.

specials.name: Tar Seam
specials.desc: Poured hot into the joint, gone hard and glossy where it pooled.

specials.name: Gutter Chrome
specials.desc: Water finding the low line, and the low line turning out to be polished.

specials.name: Night Rain
specials.desc: Vertical water against a dark building, each drop its own lens.

specials.name: Kerb Grit
specials.desc: Swept into the edge and left there — the chalkiest dark on the shelf.

specials.name: Storm Drain
specials.desc: Routed underneath everything, and the only light is what falls in.

specials.name: Blacktop Heat
specials.desc: Fresh laid and still soft, shimmering where the sun is still on it.

specials.name: Obsidian Chill
specials.desc: Cooled too fast to crystallise. Conchoidal, and sharper than surgical steel.

specials.name: Basalt Glass
specials.desc: Columns cracked by their own cooling, with a glassy skin on every face.

specials.name: Hematite
specials.desc: Iron oxide polished until it turns into a mirror that is somehow still red.

specials.name: Tourmaline Black
specials.desc: Schorl: black until you turn it, and then it is not black at all.

specials.name: Onyx Band
specials.desc: Banded chalcedony cut across the layers so the bands read as stripes.

specials.name: Magnetite
specials.desc: Lodestone in a field, standing up into spikes because it can.

specials.name: Jet Carve
specials.desc: Fossil wood cut and polished for mourning jewellery, warm to the touch.

specials.name: Shungite
specials.desc: Carbon that predates multicellular life, and conducts like it knows it.

specials.name: Anthracite
specials.desc: Hard coal with a vitreous fracture — the cleanest burn and the brightest break.

specials.name: Galena Cube
specials.desc: Lead sulphide cleaving into perfect cubes, each face a small dull mirror.

specials.name: Abyss Blue
specials.desc: Below the last light. Whatever is down there makes its own.

specials.name: Midnight Teal
specials.desc: A pool lit from under the water, at the hour the party thins out.

specials.name: Ink Well
specials.desc: Iron gall ink pooling in the bottom of the well, thick enough to stand a nib in.

specials.name: Prussian
specials.desc: The first modern synthetic blue, and still the deepest one in the box.

specials.name: Deep Pine
specials.desc: Closed canopy at dusk, where the green has gone almost to black.

specials.name: Bottle Green
specials.desc: Thick cast glass — black on edge, green through the face, and full of bubbles.

specials.name: Nocturne
specials.desc: Written to be played quietly, in a room with one lamp on.

specials.name: Cobalt Night
specials.desc: Cobalt on a dark body, fired so the pigment sinks into the glaze.

specials.name: Viridian Dark
specials.desc: Hydrated chromium oxide: a green so deep it argues with black.

specials.name: Indigo Vault
specials.desc: Twelve dips and a day in the air between each, until it stops being blue.

specials.name: Oxblood
specials.desc: Boot polish built up over years, worn back at the toe to something darker.

specials.name: Garnet Dark
specials.desc: Almandine: opaque in the hand and full of fire the moment it is lit.

specials.name: Ember Gold
specials.desc: A bed with no flame left on it, and more heat than it looks like.

specials.name: Burgundy
specials.desc: In the bottle it is black; against a candle it is not.

specials.name: Dried Rose
specials.desc: Kept in a book for a decade, gone to paper and holding the colour anyway.

specials.name: Brass Night
specials.desc: Unlacquered and left alone, so it darkens everywhere a hand does not go.

specials.name: Molten Seam
specials.desc: Cold plate with something still liquid running in the joint.

specials.name: Copper Dark
specials.desc: Roofing copper eight winters in, before the green arrives and after the shine goes.

specials.name: Rust Noir
specials.desc: Oxide advancing across a dark panel, and winning, slowly.

specials.name: Amber Vault
specials.desc: Resin with something in it, forty million years into a very slow set.

specials.name: Arc Weld
specials.desc: Strike an arc without a helmet once and you remember it for a week.

specials.name: Lightning Black
specials.desc: One channel out of a thousand attempts, and it lasts thirty microseconds.

specials.name: Filament
specials.desc: Coiled tungsten at 2800K, which is most of the way to giving up.

specials.name: Neon Scar
specials.desc: Bent glass on a black wall, and the wall is only there to hold it.

specials.name: Laser Cut
specials.desc: A kerf a quarter of a millimetre wide, with the heat colour still on the edge.

specials.name: Plasma Seam
specials.desc: Where the ionised column touches metal, and the metal notices.

specials.name: Spark Trail
specials.desc: Grinding wheel on mild steel: each spark a burning particle with a lifetime.

specials.name: Hot Wire
specials.desc: Nichrome through foam, glowing exactly as much as the current says.

specials.name: Tracer
specials.desc: Every fifth round burning, which is how you learn where the others went.

specials.name: Flashover
specials.desc: Every surface in the room reaching ignition temperature at the same moment.
