specials.name: Ireland: Aran Cable
specials.desc: Honeycomb and cable worked in undyed bainin wool, every stitch countable.

specials.name: Ireland: Burren Pavement
specials.desc: Limestone pavement scored into clints and grykes by rain that took its time.

specials.name: Ireland: Connemara Marble
specials.desc: Serpentine marble from the west — green banding folded by four hundred million years.

specials.name: Ireland: Peat Cut
specials.desc: A turf bank sliced open — ten thousand years of bog laid down in readable courses.

specials.name: Ireland: Stout Head
specials.desc: Nitrogen cascade settling into a cream head over black. The surge is the whole point.

specials.name: Norway: Arctic Light
specials.desc: Two hours of blue dusk that never becomes day, in the week either side of solstice.

specials.name: Norway: Birch Bark
specials.desc: Paper birch peeling in horizontal ribbons, each lenticel a dark dash across the white.

specials.name: Norway: Fjord Water
specials.desc: Meltwater over a drowned glacial valley, cold enough to change the colour of the light.

specials.name: Norway: Rosemaling
specials.desc: Rose painting on a dowry chest — C-scrolls and cross-hatched flowers, freehand, no pencil.

specials.name: Norway: Slate Roof
specials.desc: Riven slate hung in courses, thick at the eave and thin at the ridge, good for four hundred years.

specials.name: Portugal: Azulejo Blue
specials.desc: Cobalt on tin glaze, tile after tile up a whole façade, crazed by two centuries of weather.

specials.name: Portugal: Calçada Wave
specials.desc: Black and white limestone cubes set by hand into a rolling wave, a pavement you notice.

specials.name: Portugal: Cork Bark
specials.desc: Stripped every nine years and it grows back. Nothing else on earth does this.

specials.name: Portugal: Douro Schist
specials.desc: Terraces cut into schist so the vines can find water. The rock is the terroir.

specials.name: Portugal: Sardine Tin
specials.desc: Packed nose to tail in oil, under a lithographed lid brighter than the fish.

specials.name: Scotland: Cairngorm Granite
specials.desc: Coarse pink granite with smoky quartz in it, every crystal a different mind.

specials.name: Scotland: Cask Char
specials.desc: Level four char on American oak. The alligator skin inside is what makes the whisky.

specials.name: Scotland: Harris Tweed
specials.desc: Handwoven in the Outer Hebrides from dyed-in-the-wool yarn, so the colour is IN the fibre.

specials.name: Scotland: Heather Moor
specials.desc: Ling in full flower over peat — purple to the horizon and knee-deep in it.

specials.name: Scotland: Tartan Sett
specials.desc: One sequence of threads, reflected about its pivots and run both ways. Order you can wear.

specials.name: India: Block Print
specials.desc: Hand-cut teak blocks, one per colour, walked across the cloth by eye and never quite in register.

specials.name: India: Madras Check
specials.desc: Handloom cotton in vegetable dye, made to bleed — the fading is a feature you pay for.

specials.name: India: Marigold Mound
specials.desc: Genda strung by the kilometre and heaped at the flower market, orange past the point of sense.

specials.name: India: Mirror Work
specials.desc: Shisha discs caught under a ring of chain stitch, so a whole skirt throws light back at you.

specials.name: India: Sandstone Jali
specials.desc: A screen carved from one slab, cutting the sun into geometry and letting the wind through.

specials.name: Japan: Aizome Vat
specials.desc: Fermented indigo. The cloth comes out green and turns blue in the air while you watch.

specials.name: Japan: Kintsugi Seam
specials.desc: The break repaired in gold rather than hidden, so the history is the most valuable part.

specials.name: Japan: Raku Crackle
specials.desc: Pulled from the kiln red hot and thrown into sawdust. The crazing is the record of the shock.

specials.name: Japan: Urushi Lacquer
specials.desc: Forty coats of tree sap, each cured in a damp box and polished back with charcoal.

specials.name: Japan: Washi Fibre
specials.desc: Kozo bark beaten and floated — long fibres locked into a sheet strong enough to be a wall.

specials.name: Korea: Bojagi Patch
specials.desc: Wrapping cloth pieced from offcuts, seams flat-felled so it reads from either side.

specials.name: Korea: Celadon Glaze
specials.desc: Goryeo green — iron reduced in a starved kiln until it goes the colour of shallow water.

specials.name: Korea: Dancheong
specials.desc: Mineral pigment on temple timber — it is decoration, and it is also what stops the wood rotting.

specials.name: Korea: Hanji Sheet
specials.desc: Mulberry paper couched a hundred times. Strong enough to floor a room and be walked on.

specials.name: Korea: Najeon Inlay
specials.desc: Abalone cut into hairlines and laid into black lacquer, so the light moves when you do.

specials.name: Türkiye: Hammered Copper
specials.desc: Planished by hand in the coppersmiths' bazaar, every facet a hammer blow you can count.

specials.name: Türkiye: Iznik Tile
specials.desc: Quartz-bodied tile under a clear glaze — cobalt, turquoise, and the red that took a century to get.

specials.name: Türkiye: Kilim Weave
specials.desc: Slit-woven flatweave — no pile, so the pattern is the structure and it reads both sides.

specials.name: Türkiye: Meerschaum
specials.desc: Sepiolite carved wet and soft, then smoked for thirty years until it goes amber from the inside.

specials.name: Türkiye: Nazar Glass
specials.desc: Cobalt glass rings, wound hot on the rod and hung anywhere luck is needed.

specials.name: Egypt: Alabaster
specials.desc: Calcite banded by dripping water, cut thin enough that a lamp inside shows through the wall.

specials.name: Egypt: Desert Glass
specials.desc: Libyan silica glass — sand fused by something that came out of the sky 29 million years ago.

specials.name: Egypt: Faience Blue
specials.desc: Not clay at all — ground quartz that brings its own glaze to the surface as it dries.

specials.name: Egypt: Lapis Ground
specials.desc: Lazurite with pyrite through it, carried two thousand miles from Badakhshan to be ground up.

specials.name: Egypt: Papyrus Weave
specials.desc: Pith sliced, laid at right angles and beaten until its own sap glues it into a sheet.

specials.name: Ethiopia: Basalt Highland
specials.desc: Flood basalt stacked three kilometres deep, then split open by the rift underneath it.

specials.name: Ethiopia: Coffee Bed
specials.desc: Cherries drying on raised beds, raked by hand every hour so the ferment stays even.

specials.name: Ethiopia: Danakil Salt
specials.desc: Salt pans a hundred metres below the sea, cut into slabs and carried out by camel.

specials.name: Ethiopia: Lalibela Stone
specials.desc: Churches cut DOWN into the rock, roof first, out of one piece of the mountain.

specials.name: Ethiopia: Shamma Cotton
specials.desc: Handspun gauze worn as a shawl, so fine that the border stripe is the only weight in it.

specials.name: Mali: Bogolan Mud
specials.desc: Cloth soaked in leaf tannin, then painted with fermented river mud — the iron fixes the black.

specials.name: Mali: Brass Casting
specials.desc: Lost wax: the model is destroyed to make the object, so every casting is the only one.

specials.name: Mali: Indigo Resist
specials.desc: Tied, stitched and dipped a dozen times. Each dip is darker and the resist never quite holds.

specials.name: Mali: Kente Strip
specials.desc: Woven in narrow strips on a men's loom, then sewn edge to edge so the pattern steps.

specials.name: Mali: Laterite Road
specials.desc: Iron-rich soil that sets like brick in the sun and turns the whole country red in the dry.

specials.name: Morocco: Atlas Cedar
specials.desc: Carved cedar ceilings, cut from trees that were old when the city was founded.

specials.name: Morocco: Saffron Souk
specials.desc: Cones of ground spice built by hand and rebuilt every morning after the wind gets at them.

specials.name: Morocco: Tadelakt
specials.desc: Lime plaster burnished with a river stone and sealed with black soap until it holds water.

specials.name: Morocco: Tannery Vats
specials.desc: Stone wells of dye and pigeon lime in Fez, worked exactly as they were in the eleventh century.

specials.name: Morocco: Zellij Star
specials.desc: Every piece chipped to shape by hand from a fired tile and set face-down into the bed.

specials.name: Brazil: Amazon Canopy
specials.desc: Closed canopy from above — a single surface made of ten thousand competing crowns.

specials.name: Brazil: Calçadão
specials.desc: Copacabana's black and white wave, laid stone by stone the length of the beach.

specials.name: Brazil: Carnival Block
specials.desc: Sequin, feather and float paint at four in the morning, all of it built to last one night.

specials.name: Brazil: Cocoa Pod
specials.desc: Ridged pods cut from the trunk itself, then fermented in banana leaf for a week.

specials.name: Brazil: Tourmaline
specials.desc: Watermelon crystal: green rind, white ring, pink core, all grown in one go.

specials.name: Cuba: Havana Facade
specials.desc: Colonial paint sixteen layers deep, each one failing to a different colour underneath.

specials.name: Cuba: Malecón Spray
specials.desc: Eight kilometres of sea wall and the Atlantic coming straight over it onto the road.

specials.name: Cuba: Sugar Crystal
specials.desc: Raw crystals off the centrifuge, still warm, still smelling of the cane field.

specials.name: Cuba: Tobacco Leaf
specials.desc: Vuelta Abajo wrapper, cured in a barn for fifty days until the veins go the colour of the leaf.

specials.name: Cuba: Vintage Lacquer
specials.desc: A '55 Bel Air kept alive for seventy years on house paint, marine varnish and stubbornness.

specials.name: Jamaica: Allspice Bark
specials.desc: Pimento — one tree that tastes like four spices, and the wood smokes the jerk pit.

specials.name: Jamaica: Blue Mountain
specials.desc: Cloud forest above 1500 metres, where the mist is what makes the coffee worth the price.

specials.name: Jamaica: Rasta Weave
specials.desc: Knitted bands in red, gold and green, worn as a tam and stretched by what is under it.

specials.name: Jamaica: Sea Glass
specials.desc: Bottle glass rolled by surf until the edges go and the surface frosts right through.

specials.name: Jamaica: Sound System
specials.desc: Scoops and tweeter boxes stacked to the ceiling, built by the crew that runs them.

specials.name: Peru: Alpaca Weave
specials.desc: Hollow fibre, warmer than wool and no lanolin in it, spun on a drop spindle while walking.

specials.name: Peru: Andes Strata
specials.desc: Rainbow Mountain: marine sediment, iron and copper folded upright and then stripped bare.

specials.name: Peru: Chicha Morada
specials.desc: Purple corn boiled with pineapple rind and clove until the colour is frankly unreasonable.

specials.name: Peru: Cusco Textile
specials.desc: Backstrap loom, warp-faced, so the pattern lives entirely in threads you never see cross.

specials.name: Peru: Salt Terrace
specials.desc: Maras: three thousand evaporation ponds fed by one warm spring, worked since before the Inca.

specials.name: Aotearoa: Black Sand
specials.desc: Titanomagnetite off the volcanoes, hot enough to burn your feet on a cloudy day.

specials.name: Aotearoa: Geothermal
specials.desc: Silica terraces and mud pots at Rotorua, rebuilt daily by water coming up too hot to touch.

specials.name: Aotearoa: Greenstone
specials.desc: Nephrite from the West Coast rivers, tougher than steel and worked only by abrasion.

specials.name: Aotearoa: Kauri Gum
specials.desc: Resin buried in swamp for thirty thousand years and dug out again with a spear.

specials.name: Aotearoa: Silver Fern
specials.desc: Ponga frond, white underneath, laid face-down to mark a track you can follow by moonlight.

specials.name: Australia: Desert Varnish
specials.desc: Manganese and clay laid on rock by microbes at a micron a millennium, and it shines.

specials.name: Australia: Eucalypt Bark
specials.desc: Ribbon gum shedding in long strips, leaving fresh green-grey skin underneath.

specials.name: Australia: Ochre Bed
specials.desc: Iron oxide laid down in bands and quarried for forty thousand years as pigment.

specials.name: Australia: Opal Seam
specials.desc: Silica spheres stacked regularly enough to diffract — the fire is structure, not pigment.

specials.name: Australia: Salt Pan
specials.desc: Lake Eyre dry: a crust that polygonises as it shrinks and floods once a decade.

specials.name: Indonesia: Batik Wax
specials.desc: Drawn in hot wax with a canting, dyed, boiled off, and drawn again for the next colour.

specials.name: Indonesia: Ikat Warp
specials.desc: The thread is dyed before it is woven, so the design arrives already blurred. That IS the craft.

specials.name: Indonesia: Spice Heap
specials.desc: Nutmeg and mace from islands the world fought a war over. Two spices, one seed.

specials.name: Indonesia: Teak Grain
specials.desc: Oil in the grain itself, which is why a teak deck survives what it survives.

specials.name: Indonesia: Volcanic Sand
specials.desc: Ash from a caldera that emptied itself, farmed within a decade because nothing grows better.

specials.name: Philippines: Abaca Fibre
specials.desc: Banana-family fibre strong enough to have rigged the world's ships, woven here into cloth.

specials.name: Philippines: Capiz Shell
specials.desc: Windowpane oyster cut into squares and set in wooden lattice, translucent and cool.

specials.name: Philippines: Jeepney Chrome
specials.desc: Stainless bodywork, hand-cut trim and more paint than the mechanicals are worth.

specials.name: Philippines: Mayon Ash
specials.desc: The most perfect cone on earth, and the ash fall that keeps it that shape.

specials.name: Philippines: Rice Terrace
specials.desc: Two thousand years of contour walls at Banaue, still fed by the same irrigation.

specials.name: Mint: Denomination Foil
specials.desc: The holographic patch, stamped in register and struck through with rose-engine work.

specials.name: Mint: Fresh Sheet
specials.desc: Thirty-two notes to a sheet, uncut, before the guillotine ever touches them.

specials.name: Mint: Intaglio Plate
specials.desc: Line engraving with the ink standing proud of the paper — the one security feature you check with a thumbnail.

specials.name: Mint: Microtext Field
specials.desc: Lettering below the resolution of any copier, woven into a field of language you can almost read.

specials.name: Mint: Optically Variable
specials.desc: Ink with interference flakes in it — the denomination that changes colour when the car turns.

specials.name: Mint: Rose Engine
specials.desc: A lathe that cuts interfering rosettes no hand can redraw. The machine is called a rose engine; this is its output.

specials.name: Mint: Security Thread
specials.desc: A metal ribbon buried in the pulp, surfacing through windows, with the mill's loose fibres scattered around it.

specials.name: Mint: Watermark Pulp
specials.desc: Not printed at all — the dandy roll pressed the pulp thinner, and the portrait is a map of paper thickness.

specials.name: Vault: Armoured Glass
specials.desc: Laminate that stops the round and keeps the spall, cracked into a web that holds together.

specials.name: Vault: Bullion Stack
specials.desc: Four hundred troy ounces a bar, stacked five high, each one softer than you expect.

specials.name: Vault: Cage Mesh
specials.desc: Expanded steel between you and the money, close enough to see through and not to reach through.

specials.name: Vault: Deposit Brass
specials.desc: A wall of safe-deposit doors, every one with a name on it and two locks.

specials.name: Vault: Hardplate
specials.desc: Manganese hardplate — the layer a drill bit dies in. Cross-cut so the carbide skates.

specials.name: Vault: Night Deposit
specials.desc: The chute in the wall, painted the green every bank painted everything until 1979.

specials.name: Vault: Tamper Seal
specials.desc: A seal designed to destroy itself: void lettering that surfaces the instant anyone lifts an edge.

specials.name: Vault: Timelock
specials.desc: Clockwork that refuses to open before morning, in polished brass and jewelled bearings.

specials.name: Asset: Bearer Deed
specials.desc: Whoever holds the paper owns the thing. No name on it anywhere, which is exactly the point.

specials.name: Asset: Brilliant Cut
specials.desc: Fifty-seven facets arranged so light that goes in has to come back at you.

specials.name: Asset: Bullion Pour
specials.desc: Molten gold entering a mould — the moment before it becomes a number in a ledger.

specials.name: Asset: Leaf Gilding
specials.desc: Gold beaten to a fifth of a micron, laid down in leaves that never quite meet.

specials.name: Asset: Platinum Ingot
specials.desc: Denser than gold, rarer than gold, and it does not care what you think of it.

specials.name: Asset: Share Certificate
specials.desc: An engraved allegory of Industry, a serial number, and a claim on something you will never see.

specials.name: Asset: Title Vellum
specials.desc: Calfskin, a wax seal and a hand that has been dust for two centuries. Still enforceable.

specials.name: Asset: Watch Movement
specials.desc: Côtes de Genève on a bridge nobody will ever look at, because it should be right anyway.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Bleached Note
specials.desc: A one washed to blank and reprinted as a hundred. The paper is genuine, which is the clever part.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Laundered
specials.desc: Through a restaurant, a car wash and a shell in Nicosia, and it comes out the other side clean.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Plated Brass
specials.desc: Two microns of gold over brass, and it wears through exactly where a thumb would rest.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Rescreened
specials.desc: Photographed and reprinted. The scanner's grid beat against the engraving and left its confession.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Salted Bar
specials.desc: Right weight, right stamp, tungsten core. It only fails the one test nobody runs.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Superdollar
specials.desc: State-made, intaglio-printed, better paper than the original. The engraving is only wrong in one line.

specials.name: Counterfeit: UV Dead
specials.desc: Perfect in daylight. Under the lamp at the till, the fibres that should light up stay black.

specials.name: Counterfeit: Wrong Watermark
specials.desc: Printed on, not pressed in. It reads correctly flat and vanishes the moment you hold it up.

specials.name: Burn: Bond Ash
specials.desc: Cold ash holding the shape of the certificate right up until the moment you touch it.

specials.name: Burn: Burn A Stack
specials.desc: A strapped brick going up all at once — the scorch corona running ahead of the black.

specials.name: Burn: Confetti Drop
specials.desc: A year's bonus turned into ticker tape and thrown off a balcony.

specials.name: Burn: Cross Cut
specials.desc: Security-grade shredding: 2mm strips, cross-cut, unreconstructable and oddly beautiful.

specials.name: Burn: Hyperinflation
specials.desc: A hundred trillion of something, printed on one side because the second pass costs more than the note.

specials.name: Burn: Ink Spill
specials.desc: The dye pack goes off in the bag and marks every note, and the money is still money and worth nothing.

specials.name: Burn: Ticker Crash
specials.desc: Tape running faster than anyone can read it, all of it in one direction.

specials.name: Burn: Torn In Half
specials.desc: Half a note is worth nothing, so tearing one is the purest way to spend money on a gesture.

specials.name: Woven: Burlap Glaze
specials.desc: Open-weave sacking, glazed as though it had been through a kiln.

specials.name: Woven: Canvas Pearl
specials.desc: Artist's canvas, sized and stretched, behaving like a tri-coat pearl.

specials.name: Woven: Corduroy Liquid
specials.desc: Wales running true down the panel, and each one is a standing wave of liquid.

specials.name: Woven: Denim Chrome
specials.desc: Twill you could count the picks on, and every one of them is a mirror.

specials.name: Woven: Felt Carrier
specials.desc: Pressed fibre, no weave at all — and it thresholds under a floodlight like cut metal.

specials.name: Woven: Hessian Mercury
specials.desc: Coarse jute sacking, thread for thread — machined out of a single block of mercury.

specials.name: Woven: Knit Liquid
specials.desc: Every loop of the knit intact, and the whole surface still moving.

specials.name: Woven: Silk Carrier
specials.desc: Cloth caught mid-drape, made of a material that only exists after dark.

specials.name: Woven: Tweed Mirror
specials.desc: Flecked country cloth with the optics of a polished ingot.

specials.name: Woven: Wool Glass
specials.desc: Carded wool with the surface tension of poured glass.

specials.name: Grown: Bark Chrome
specials.desc: Deep fissured bark you could put your fingers into, mirror-polished.

specials.name: Grown: Coral Glass
specials.desc: A calcified reef, still porous, and clear all the way through.

specials.name: Grown: Fur Carrier
specials.desc: Dense pelt lying one way, which under lights behaves like the Fractured rail.

specials.name: Grown: Hide Pearl
specials.desc: Full-grain leather with its pores intact, finished as a pearl coat.

specials.name: Grown: Leaf Liquid
specials.desc: Venation from midrib to margin, and the whole leaf is still pouring.

specials.name: Grown: Lichen Mercury
specials.desc: Crustose lichen spreading on rock, rendered as a liquid metal colony.

specials.name: Grown: Moss Glass
specials.desc: Sphagnum, every frond resolved, cast in optical glass.

specials.name: Grown: Petal Liquid
specials.desc: Petal tissue with the light behaving as though the flower were poured.

specials.name: Grown: Root Mercury
specials.desc: A root mat pulled out of the soil intact, every hair of it liquid metal.

specials.name: Grown: Spore Pearl
specials.desc: A fruiting mat gone velvet — and finished like a show car.

specials.name: Mineral: Basalt Mirror
specials.desc: Columnar basalt in plan view, each column a perfect mirror.

specials.name: Mineral: Chalk Chrome
specials.desc: Blackboard chalk — the most matte thing there is — polished to a mirror.

specials.name: Mineral: Concrete Liquid
specials.desc: Board-marked concrete with the aggregate showing, and it has not set.

specials.name: Mineral: Granite Mercury
specials.desc: Coarse-grained granite, every crystal visible, machined out of mercury.

specials.name: Mineral: Grit Carrier
specials.desc: Blasting grit at rest, which after dark stops behaving like a mineral at all.

specials.name: Mineral: Gypsum Glass
specials.desc: Fibrous gypsum — satin spar — taken all the way to optical clarity.

specials.name: Mineral: Pumice Pearl
specials.desc: Volcanic foam, light enough to float, finished like a concours pearl.

specials.name: Mineral: Sandstone Liquid
specials.desc: Cross-bedded sandstone with every lamina readable, and it is flowing.

specials.name: Mineral: Slate Glass
specials.desc: Riven slate, split along its cleavage, and completely transparent.

specials.name: Mineral: Terracotta Carrier
specials.desc: Unglazed fired clay that ignites into the carrier the moment lights hit it.

specials.name: Made: Blotter Glass
specials.desc: Absorbent blotting stock, which drinks light and somehow also transmits it.

specials.name: Made: Card Pearl
specials.desc: Folded card stock with the crease still crisp, sprayed like a show finish.

specials.name: Made: Chipboard Liquid
specials.desc: Pressed chip and resin, every flake showing, in the middle of pouring.

specials.name: Made: Cork Pearl
specials.desc: Cellular cork, every cell open, finished as a three-stage pearl.

specials.name: Made: Corrugate Mercury
specials.desc: Single-wall board with the flutes running true — poured, not folded.

specials.name: Made: Greyboard Carrier
specials.desc: Book board. The dullest material in any workshop, and it fractures under light.

specials.name: Made: Kraft Chrome
specials.desc: Unbleached kraft paper with the fibre lay visible, and it is solid chrome.

specials.name: Made: Newsprint Glass
specials.desc: Cheap paper stock, showing its screen, and clear as a lens.

specials.name: Made: Plywood Liquid
specials.desc: Rotary-cut veneer with the grain sweeping across it, and it has not stopped moving.

specials.name: Made: Sawdust Mirror
specials.desc: Swarf and dust from the saw, every particle a facet.

specials.name: Ruined: Ash Chrome
specials.desc: Cold wood ash. Nothing on earth reflects less, and this reflects everything.

specials.name: Ruined: Cinder Mirror
specials.desc: Burnt-out clinker from the bottom of a grate, polished like jewellery.

specials.name: Ruined: Corrosion Glass
specials.desc: Pitting corrosion eating into the metal, and each pit is a lens.

specials.name: Ruined: Decay Pearl
specials.desc: Rot doing its work, finished to a standard the object never had when new.

specials.name: Ruined: Flake Carrier
specials.desc: Failing paint curling off the substrate, each flake carrying the Fractured rail.

specials.name: Ruined: Mould Liquid
specials.desc: A colony spreading across a damp wall, and the whole wall is running.

specials.name: Ruined: Rust Mirror
specials.desc: Scaling iron oxide lifting off in plates, and every plate is a mirror.

specials.name: Ruined: Soot Pearl
specials.desc: Carbon black, the deadest pigment there is, laid down as a pearl.

specials.name: Ruined: Verdigris Glass
specials.desc: Copper carbonate crusting a roof, and you can see straight through it.

specials.name: Ruined: Weathered Liquid
specials.desc: Timber silvered by forty years of weather, and it is pouring off the panel.

specials.name: Rain: Downpour
specials.desc: Rain hard enough to be a surface of its own, and the road answering it.

specials.name: Rain: Cloudburst
specials.desc: Every drop lands at once — a whole sheet of overlapping impact rings.

specials.name: Rain: Drizzle
specials.desc: Too fine to hear, wet enough to soak you. Rain you only see against a light.

specials.name: Rain: Sheet Rain
specials.desc: Wind-driven and near-horizontal, arriving in visible sheets across the tarmac.

specials.name: Rain: Monsoon
specials.desc: A season, not a shower — warm rain with the whole sky committed to it.

specials.name: Rain: Acid Rain
specials.desc: Rain that leaves a mark: etched pits where each drop sat and worked.

specials.name: Rain: Puddle Skin
specials.desc: Standing water with the wind fretting it and oil-film drifting on top.

specials.name: Rain: Dew Field
specials.desc: Condensation beaded on cold paint, each bead its own tiny lens.

specials.name: Rain: Petrichor
specials.desc: Dry ground taking the first rain — dark patches spreading and joining.

specials.name: Rain: Gutter Race
specials.desc: Water finding the low line and running it faster than anything else on the road.

specials.name: Rain: Windscreen
specials.desc: Beads shearing sideways and joining into rivulets the moment you move.

specials.name: Rain: Virga
specials.desc: Rain that never lands — it evaporates on the way down and hangs there instead.

specials.name: Frozen: Blizzard
specials.desc: Snow moving sideways fast enough that the ground and the sky stop being different.

specials.name: Frozen: Snowdrift
specials.desc: Wind sculpting snow the same way it sculpts sand, and just as sharply.

specials.name: Frozen: Sleet
specials.desc: Half rain, half ice, and unpleasant in a way neither of them manages alone.

specials.name: Frozen: Hail Damage
specials.desc: Dents you can feel through the paint, each one a stone that fell out of a cloud.

specials.name: Frozen: Hoarfrost
specials.desc: Water going straight from vapour to crystal, feathering out on every cold edge.

specials.name: Frozen: Rime Ice
specials.desc: Freezing fog building into the wind, so the ice grows toward the weather.

specials.name: Frozen: Black Ice
specials.desc: Invisible until it is far too late — clear ice over dark tarmac.

specials.name: Frozen: Frost Fern
specials.desc: Window frost: ferns that grow along scratches you never knew the glass had.

specials.name: Frozen: Diamond Dust
specials.desc: Ice crystals falling out of a clear sky, each one catching the sun on its way.

specials.name: Frozen: Permafrost
specials.desc: Ground that has not thawed in ten thousand years, cracked into contraction polygons.

specials.name: Frozen: Serac Field
specials.desc: A glacier breaking over a step: blocks the size of houses, none of them stable.

specials.name: Frozen: Graupel
specials.desc: Soft hail — snowflakes that fell through supercooled cloud and came out rimed.

specials.name: Storm: Tornado Alley
specials.desc: Rotation you can see. The field turns before the funnel ever touches down.

specials.name: Storm: Supercell
specials.desc: One storm with its own rotating updraught, which is why it lasts all afternoon.

specials.name: Storm: Hurricane Eye
specials.desc: Bands wrapped tight enough to leave a hole in the middle where it is completely calm.

specials.name: Storm: Squall Line
specials.desc: A wall of weather a hundred miles long arriving all at once.

specials.name: Storm: Gust Front
specials.desc: The cold air a storm pushes ahead of itself, rolling and picking up everything loose.

specials.name: Storm: Mammatus
specials.desc: Pouches hanging under the anvil — sinking air, and a sky that looks upside down.

specials.name: Storm: Wall Cloud
specials.desc: The lowered base under the updraught. If anything is going to happen, it happens here.

specials.name: Storm: Lightning Strike
specials.desc: One channel out of a thousand attempts, and it lasts about thirty microseconds.

specials.name: Storm: Thunderhead
specials.desc: Twelve kilometres of vertical development, flattened at the top where it hit the stratosphere.

specials.name: Storm: Microburst
specials.desc: Air falling out of a cloud fast enough to spread sideways when it lands.

specials.name: Storm: Waterspout
specials.desc: A tornado that found the sea and started lifting it.

specials.name: Storm: Derecho
specials.desc: Straight-line wind that keeps going for six hundred miles without rotating once.

specials.name: Water: Tsunami
specials.desc: Not a wave — a change in sea level that happens to be moving at jet speed.

specials.name: Water: Breaker
specials.desc: The moment the wave face outruns its own base and the top has nowhere to go.

specials.name: Water: Whitewater
specials.desc: Air beaten into water until it stops being either one.

specials.name: Water: Tide Race
specials.desc: A whole ocean forced through a gap, and the seams where the flows shear past each other.

specials.name: Water: Storm Surge
specials.desc: The sea arriving somewhere it does not belong, pushed by a low-pressure centre.

specials.name: Water: Riptide
specials.desc: A narrow river running out through the surf, and the reason you swim sideways.

specials.name: Water: Spindrift
specials.desc: Spray torn off the wave tops and carried until it is more air than water.

specials.name: Water: Whirlpool
specials.desc: Two tides meeting on a shelf and neither of them giving way.

specials.name: Water: Chop
specials.desc: Short, steep, confused water — the wind arguing with the swell underneath it.

specials.name: Water: Glassy Swell
specials.desc: Long-period energy from a storm a thousand miles away, arriving in perfect order.

specials.name: Water: Flood Line
specials.desc: Silt and debris marking exactly how high it got, all the way along.

specials.name: Water: Foam Lace
specials.desc: What is left on the sand after the wave goes back — a lace of bubbles, briefly.

specials.name: Dry: Sandstorm
specials.desc: Visibility measured in metres, and the sound of your own paint being taken off.

specials.name: Dry: Haboob
specials.desc: A wall of dust a mile high rolling ahead of a collapsing thunderstorm.

specials.name: Dry: Dust Devil
specials.desc: Ground heated until the air above it has to leave, spinning as it goes.

specials.name: Dry: Heat Shimmer
specials.desc: Air of two different densities in the same place, and the road bending because of it.

specials.name: Dry: Drought Crack
specials.desc: Clay that has given up all its water and shrunk away from itself.

specials.name: Dry: Mirage
specials.desc: An inverted image of the sky lying on the road, and it stays exactly as far away.

specials.name: Dry: Dust Veil
specials.desc: Fine enough to stay up for weeks and to make the sunsets worth watching.

specials.name: Dry: Salt Haze
specials.desc: A dry lake giving its crust back to the wind one flake at a time.

specials.name: Dry: Harmattan
specials.desc: A trade wind carrying the Sahara west until it reaches the sea and beyond.

specials.name: Dry: Sirocco
specials.desc: Desert air pulled north across the Mediterranean, arriving hot and full of grit.

specials.name: Dry: Loess
specials.desc: Windblown silt laid down in beds deep enough to farm and soft enough to carve.

specials.name: Dry: Brownout
specials.desc: Rotor wash lifting the whole surface at once, and the ground disappearing from under you.

specials.name: Contact: Saucer Alloy
specials.desc: Spun machined hull: concentric turn-rings still on the alloy from the lathe that made it.

specials.name: Contact: Hull Plating
specials.desc: Irregular alien plates, recessed seams, fastener rows, and no two panels polished alike.

specials.name: Contact: Glyph Script
specials.desc: Angular xeno writing — strokes cluster into words, so it reads as language, not scatter.

specials.name: Contact: Crop Geometry
specials.desc: Flattened agroglyph rings laid across a standing crop that all leans one way.

specials.name: Contact: Abduction Column
specials.desc: A leaning forest of light columns with the dust caught turning inside them.

specials.name: Contact: Tractor Well
specials.desc: Beam wells pulsing tight concentric pull-rings into whatever is underneath.

specials.name: Contact: Bio-Mech Chitin
specials.desc: Interlocking chitin plate and the vein bundles running between them. Grown, not built.

specials.name: Contact: Reactor Lattice
specials.desc: An isometric strut scaffold with the containment charge running the struts.

specials.name: Contact: Beacon Array
specials.desc: Emitter grid mid-broadcast: every cell on its own phase of the same signal.

specials.name: Contact: Cloaking Field
specials.desc: The hull half-there: a refractive skin that bends the background instead of hiding it.

specials.name: Contact: Probe Skin
specials.desc: Sensor pits and apertures sunk flush into a plated skin that has been out there a while.

specials.name: Contact: Signal Bloom
specials.desc: A transmission leaving: expanding wavefronts stacked over the antenna that threw them.

specials.name: Worlds: Regolith
specials.desc: Four billion years of impact gardening: dust turned over so often it has no bedrock left.

specials.name: Worlds: Crater Field
specials.desc: Big enough to have rims and ejecta blankets, and each one has been hit again since.

specials.name: Worlds: Ice Moon
specials.desc: A shell of ice cracked and re-frozen so many times the lines cross their own history.

specials.name: Worlds: Sulfur Volcanics
specials.desc: Sulfur flows in every allotrope colour, laid down and buried on a world that never stops.

specials.name: Worlds: Gas Giant Bands
specials.desc: Zonal flow: belts running the opposite way to their neighbours, with storms caught between.

specials.name: Worlds: Storm Oval
specials.desc: An anticyclone that has outlived every telescope pointed at it, kept fed by the shear.

specials.name: Worlds: Dune Sea
specials.desc: Barchan dunes all marching the same way because one wind has had the whole planet to itself.

specials.name: Worlds: Salt Flat
specials.desc: Evaporite polygons: the floor of a sea that left, cracked into plates as it dried.

specials.name: Worlds: Basalt Plain
specials.desc: Flood basalt with wrinkle ridges — a lava ocean that cooled and then shrugged.

specials.name: Worlds: Methane Lake
specials.desc: Dark hydrocarbon under an orange haze, with a shoreline that rain keeps redrawing.

specials.name: Worlds: Ring Shadow
specials.desc: The ring system printing its own gaps onto the cloud deck below it.

specials.name: Worlds: Terminator
specials.desc: The line where the sun is setting: every crater rim throwing a shadow the length of itself.

specials.name: Deep Field: Star Nursery
specials.desc: Pillars being eaten from the outside by the stars they just finished making.

specials.name: Deep Field: Emission Nebula
specials.desc: Hydrogen ionised by everything young and hot inside it, glowing at one wavelength.

specials.name: Deep Field: Dark Nebula
specials.desc: Not empty — full. Cold dust thick enough to delete the stars behind it.

specials.name: Deep Field: Globular Cluster
specials.desc: A hundred thousand old stars packed so tightly the sky there never gets dark.

specials.name: Deep Field: Spiral Arm
specials.desc: A density wave, not a structure — the arm stays put while the stars pass through.

specials.name: Deep Field: Dust Lane
specials.desc: The dark band across a galaxy's face, edge-on and absolutely opaque.

specials.name: Deep Field: Deep Field
specials.desc: Point the telescope at nothing for eleven days and this is what nothing turns out to be.

specials.name: Deep Field: Reflection Nebula
specials.desc: Dust that is not glowing at all — only scattering blue light from a star out of frame.

specials.name: Deep Field: Planetary Nebula
specials.desc: A dying star's outer shell thrown off in stages, lit from inside by the core it left.

specials.name: Deep Field: Filament Web
specials.desc: Large-scale structure: galaxies strung on filaments around voids the size of nothing else.

specials.name: Deep Field: Zodiacal Light
specials.desc: Sunlight scattered off the dust in our own plane — the faintest thing you can see.

specials.name: Deep Field: Molecular Cloud
specials.desc: Cold, clumpy, and barely holding together — every clump a star that has not decided yet.

specials.name: Event: Event Horizon
specials.desc: The photon ring: light that went round more than once before it got out.

specials.name: Event: Accretion Disc
specials.desc: Gas shearing against itself on the way in, and getting hot enough to be the brightest thing here.

specials.name: Event: Gravitational Lens
specials.desc: Arcs and rings — the same galaxy, imaged four times by the mass in front of it.

specials.name: Event: Wormhole Throat
specials.desc: Nested funnels where the geometry stops agreeing with the distance.

specials.name: Event: Supernova Remnant
specials.desc: Ragged filament shells still expanding into whatever the star's wind cleared out first.

specials.name: Event: Pulsar Beam
specials.desc: A lighthouse turning thirty times a second, and you only exist when the beam is on you.

specials.name: Event: Magnetar Flare
specials.desc: Field lines snapping and reconnecting on a crust that just cracked.

specials.name: Event: Relativistic Jet
specials.desc: Collimated, knotted, and moving at a speed that makes the far side of it invisible.

specials.name: Event: Bow Shock
specials.desc: Where something moving fast meets something already there, and the medium piles up.

specials.name: Event: Tidal Stream
specials.desc: A companion galaxy pulled into a thread and wound round its own host.

specials.name: Event: Kilonova
specials.desc: Two neutron stars finished. Every heavy element in your body was made in one of these.

specials.name: Event: Frame Drag
specials.desc: Spacetime itself wound up by the rotation, so standing still is no longer available.

specials.name: Vessel: Heat Shield
specials.desc: Ablative char: the shield works by being destroyed at a rate somebody calculated exactly.

specials.name: Vessel: MLI Foil
specials.desc: Multi-layer insulation, crumpled gold — the crinkles are the point, not damage.

specials.name: Vessel: Solar Sail
specials.desc: A membrane thinner than a bin bag and the size of a football pitch, pushed by light.

specials.name: Vessel: Radiator Panel
specials.desc: White honeycomb whose whole job is to be cold, facing the direction with nothing in it.

specials.name: Vessel: Whipple Shield
specials.desc: Sacrificial outer layer, pitted by grains travelling at ten kilometres a second.

specials.name: Vessel: Thermal Blanket
specials.desc: Quilted kapton, stitched into cells so a puncture stays a puncture and not a tear.

specials.name: Vessel: Sun Shade
specials.desc: Five layers, each one colder than the last, holding a mirror at forty kelvin.

specials.name: Vessel: Mirror Segment
specials.desc: Gold on beryllium, eighteen hexagons aligned to a fraction of the light they collect.

specials.name: Vessel: Docking Ring
specials.desc: A machined collar built so two things moving at eight kilometres a second can touch gently.

specials.name: Vessel: Ablation Streak
specials.desc: Re-entry flow written onto the shield: every streak is where the plasma went.

specials.name: Vessel: Cryo Tank
specials.desc: Frost creeping over insulation, because the thing inside is colder than the sky.

specials.name: Vessel: Beacon Strobe
specials.desc: Anti-collision strobe on a hull that nothing is close enough to collide with.

specials.name: Cyanide Hour
specials.desc: Teal all day; at the first floodlight it turns to hot copper and stays there.

specials.name: Ember Verdict
specials.desc: Slate blue with a filament network that only announces itself as ember after dark.

specials.name: Violet Sentence
specials.desc: Sober olive by day, liquid violet by night — the braid does the handing over.

specials.name: Copper Confession
specials.desc: Sea-green drift that confesses to copper under the lights.

specials.name: Magenta Testimony
specials.desc: A chalk-green plate whose crack network burns magenta at night.

specials.name: Ice to Rust
specials.desc: Lifted ice plates that oxidise the moment the sun leaves.

specials.name: Jade Reversal
specials.desc: Jade cells, rose-mirror seams — the two never appear together.

specials.name: Sodium Trial
specials.desc: Cold blue bed with sodium-lamp amber waiting inside it.

specials.name: Aqua Betrayal
specials.desc: An aqua burn front that turns blood-red under a point light.

specials.name: Chartreuse Alibi
specials.desc: Acid-green powder coat; the dendrites hold an indigo alibi for after dark.

specials.name: Slate Ember
specials.desc: Creased slate that keeps a bed of embers in every fold.

specials.name: Harbour Amber
specials.desc: Cold harbour grey braided with the amber of the dock lamps.

specials.name: Gunsmoke Coal
specials.desc: Gunsmoke plates with coal-red heat surviving underneath them.

specials.name: Frost Filament
specials.desc: Frosted ceramic threaded with filaments that light warm.

specials.name: Deep Water Forge
specials.desc: Deep-water drift with a forge glow under the surface.

specials.name: Pewter Sunset
specials.desc: Pewter cells that each hold one sunset.

specials.name: Storm Copper
specials.desc: Storm-grey fingering shot through with old copper.

specials.name: Blue Hour Brass
specials.desc: The blue hour, cracked, with brass in every fracture.

specials.name: Cinder Vault
specials.desc: A near-black vault whose floor is entirely cinder once the lamps come on.

specials.name: Anchor Rust
specials.desc: Cold anchor grey overtaken by a rust front after dark.

specials.name: Rust to Glacier
specials.desc: Rusted plate by day; every lifted edge goes glacier blue at night.

specials.name: Amber Cryonic
specials.desc: Amber cells with a cryogenic mirror sleeping in the seams.

specials.name: Terracotta Freeze
specials.desc: Terracotta that freezes solid the moment the sun drops.

specials.name: Bronze Nocturne
specials.desc: Bronze braid playing a blue nocturne after hours.

specials.name: Saffron Midnight
specials.desc: Saffron ground, midnight veins — they trade places at dusk.

specials.name: Ochre Arctic
specials.desc: Ochre drift with arctic light moving under it.

specials.name: Foundry Frost
specials.desc: Foundry heat by day, frost in the creases by night.

specials.name: Marigold Abyss
specials.desc: A marigold bed that opens onto an abyss-blue floor.

specials.name: Sienna Signal
specials.desc: Sienna field with cold signal sparks that only fire at night.

specials.name: Kiln Blue
specials.desc: A kiln-warm front that cools to blue behind it.

specials.name: Venom Curfew
specials.desc: Purple curfew broken by acid-green dendrites after dark.

specials.name: Absinthe Night
specials.desc: Rose by day; absinthe threads take the whole car at night.

specials.name: Toxic Recess
specials.desc: Indigo recess cells with a toxic charge in the walls.

specials.name: Chlorine Watch
specials.desc: Pool-blue watch that turns chlorine-green under the lamps.

specials.name: Lime Interrogation
specials.desc: Violet powder coat, lime in every crack — nothing stays hidden.

specials.name: Serpent Shift
specials.desc: Magenta braid that sheds into serpent green.

specials.name: Uranium Dusk
specials.desc: Cold plates over a uranium glow that only shows at the edges.

specials.name: Wormwood Vigil
specials.desc: A mauve vigil drifting toward wormwood by midnight.

specials.name: Acid Testament
specials.desc: Blue-violet fingering with an acid testament underneath.

specials.name: Hemlock Hour
specials.desc: Orchid front, hemlock behind it, and one hour where you see both.

specials.name: Royal Nightfall
specials.desc: Olive court by day; royal violet takes the throne at night.

specials.name: Rose Assize
specials.desc: Green bench, rose verdict — the veins deliver it.

specials.name: Gilt Sentence
specials.desc: Cold ceramic sentenced to gilt after dark.

specials.name: Imperial Drift
specials.desc: Imperial drift from moss to amethyst as the light fails.

specials.name: Orchid Curfew
specials.desc: A yellow-green braid that closes into orchid at curfew.

specials.name: Cardinal Watch
specials.desc: Green watch-plates, cardinal red beneath every lifted edge.

specials.name: Amethyst Bench
specials.desc: A powder-green bed with amethyst working up through it.

specials.name: Coronation Blue
specials.desc: Gold creases at noon, coronation blue by ten.

specials.name: Fuchsia Docket
specials.desc: Fern ground with fuchsia sparks that only strike at night.

specials.name: Last Session
specials.desc: The last session of the day: sea-green gives way to crimson mirror.

specials.name: Ignition: Flashpoint
specials.desc: The instant it catches — a ragged burn front with the first embers already thrown clear.

specials.name: Ignition: Char Creep
specials.desc: Blackening crawls across the surface along the grain, carbon dendrites trailing behind it.

specials.name: Ignition: Tinder Bloom
specials.desc: Dry fibre catching all at once: hundreds of thin bright threads opening out of a rough front.

specials.name: Ignition: Match Head
specials.desc: Crimson strontium flare — the chemical head burning ahead of the wood.

specials.name: Ignition: Smoulder Bed
specials.desc: Heat travelling underground through a packed bed, glowing only where it found air.

specials.name: Ignition: Fuse Line
specials.desc: Lilac potassium running along a powder trail, spitting as it goes.

specials.name: Ignition: Kindle Lattice
specials.desc: Stacked kindling seen from above, each cell lighting on its own schedule.

specials.name: Ignition: Spark Shower
specials.desc: White-gold thermite spray, every particle burning out along its own arc.

specials.name: Ignition: Ember Catch
specials.desc: A landed ember taking hold — bright cores spreading into the cold bed around them.

specials.name: Ignition: Pilot Ring
specials.desc: The blue pilot crown: cool methane braids holding a steady standing flame.

specials.name: Ignition: Autoignition
specials.desc: No spark needed — the whole surface reaches temperature at once and creases as it goes.

specials.name: Ignition: Firebrand Scatter
specials.desc: Burning debris carried downwind, each brand starting a new small front where it lands.

specials.name: Ignition: Scorch Front
specials.desc: The dark boundary between what has burned and what has not, creased by its own heat.

specials.name: Ignition: Ignition Delay
specials.desc: Fuel and air mixed but not yet lit — pale sulfur blue drifting over a cold bed.

specials.name: Ignition: Touchpaper
specials.desc: Amber sodium creeping through treated paper along every fibre at once.

specials.name: Flame: Diffusion Sheet
specials.desc: Where fuel meets air the burn is a SURFACE, not a volume — a shoal of thin reaction sheets.

specials.name: Flame: Wrinkled Front
specials.desc: Michelson-Sivashinsky cusping: a flame front unstable to its own curvature, creasing everywhere.

specials.name: Flame: Darrieus Cell
specials.desc: Darrieus-Landau cellular instability — a premixed flame breaking into its own honeycomb.

specials.name: Flame: Turbulent Braid
specials.desc: Shear at the flame edge rolling into braid after braid, never one big billow.

specials.name: Flame: Flamelet Storm
specials.desc: Turbulence tears the front into thousands of independent flamelets, each burning on its own.

specials.name: Flame: Buoyant Fingers
specials.desc: Rayleigh-Taylor: hot gas punching up through cold in a hundred small fingers.

specials.name: Flame: Shear Tongue
specials.desc: Amber tongues leaning off a shear layer, licked into ribbons by the crossflow.

specials.name: Flame: Pool Puff
specials.desc: A pool fire breathing — the periodic puff of a buoyant plume, resolved into cells.

specials.name: Flame: Candle Cone
specials.desc: The quiet laminar burn of a wick, all its structure in the fine creases of the sheath.

specials.name: Flame: Blowtorch
specials.desc: Forced-air blue: the flame stretched thin and fast, streaks running with the jet.

specials.name: Flame: Backdraft Wrinkle
specials.desc: Starved, then fed — the front folds back on itself the instant the air arrives.

specials.name: Flame: Fire Whirl Grain
specials.desc: Rotation stretches every filament into the same handedness — a whirl written in grain, not in a spiral.

specials.name: Flame: Laminar Ladder
specials.desc: An orderly premixed burn: rungs of blue at a fixed spacing, cells filling between them.

specials.name: Flame: Crown Fire
specials.desc: Fire in the canopy — it stops running along the ground and starts leaping between crowns.

specials.name: Flame: Stoichiometric Seam
specials.desc: Emerald boron marking the exact ratio line where fuel and oxidiser are perfectly matched.

specials.name: Plasma: Arc Filament
specials.desc: Past burning: an ionised channel that carries current, not fuel.

specials.name: Plasma: Ionised Braid
specials.desc: Current and field braiding around each other down the length of the column.

specials.name: Plasma: Magnetised Jet
specials.desc: Copper-blue plasma collimated by its own magnetic field into a single hard direction.

specials.name: Plasma: Corona Grain
specials.desc: The violet haze at the edge of a charged surface, grainy right down to the pixel.

specials.name: Plasma: Streamer Web
specials.desc: Streamers branching ahead of the main channel, each looking for the easiest path.

specials.name: Plasma: Townsend Cascade
specials.desc: One electron becomes two, two become four — avalanche until the whole gap conducts.

specials.name: Plasma: Pinch Instability
specials.desc: The column squeezes itself, necks, and tears — sausage instability written across the surface.

specials.name: Plasma: Cathode Spot
specials.desc: Blinding white attachment points skittering across the electrode surface.

specials.name: Plasma: Glow Discharge
specials.desc: Low pressure, low current — an even green glow with visible striations in it.

specials.name: Plasma: Lichtenberg Burn
specials.desc: The fractal scar a discharge leaves behind, branching at every scale it can find.

specials.name: Plasma: Plasma Sheath
specials.desc: The thin charged skin that forms wherever plasma meets a solid wall.

specials.name: Plasma: Spectral Line
specials.desc: Apple-green barium emitting on one narrow line and nothing else.

specials.name: Plasma: Electron Avalanche
specials.desc: Every track a carrier multiplying as it runs; the surface saturates from the leading edge back.

specials.name: Plasma: Tokamak Ripple
specials.desc: Confined and stable — nested flux surfaces rippling in step.

specials.name: Plasma: Aurora Column
specials.desc: Charged particles following field lines down — curtains of green standing on end.

specials.name: Molten: Pahoehoe Skin
specials.desc: The ropy skin of slow lava, folding over itself as the crust drags on the flow beneath.

specials.name: Molten: Slag Crust
specials.desc: Waste glass floating on the melt, cracked into plates with heat still showing through the seams.

specials.name: Molten: Lava Cell
specials.desc: Convection cells on an open melt — dark crust above, orange shear at every boundary.

specials.name: Molten: Quench Craze
specials.desc: Hot glass into cold water: a craze network that keeps sub-dividing its own biggest fragments.

specials.name: Molten: Vitrified Glaze
specials.desc: Ash fused to a glassy skin, then cooled until it crazed — kiln chemistry, not paint.

specials.name: Molten: Weld Pool
specials.desc: The frozen ripple record of a moving arc, each crescent one pulse of the weld.

specials.name: Molten: Molten Drip
specials.desc: White-hot metal running and freezing on the way down, in hundreds of fine rivulets.

specials.name: Molten: Crucible Skin
specials.desc: Oxide plates lifting off the wall of a crucible, each curled at the edge and lit underneath.

specials.name: Molten: Basalt Column
specials.desc: Cooling contraction cracking a flow into columns — the same physics as mud, at 1200 degrees.

specials.name: Molten: Obsidian Chill
specials.desc: Cooled too fast to crystallise: black glass with conchoidal fracture running through it.

specials.name: Molten: Foundry Spatter
specials.desc: Thrown metal freezing where it lands, pocking the plate it lands on.

specials.name: Molten: Tuyere Glow
specials.desc: Looking in through the blast port: the hottest zone of the furnace, seen through moving gas.

specials.name: Molten: Slumped Glass
specials.desc: Glass gone soft and taken the shape it was resting on, the flow still legible in the surface.

specials.name: Molten: Magma Vesicle
specials.desc: Gas coming out of solution — bubbles frozen at the instant the melt stopped moving.

specials.name: Molten: Ropy Flow
specials.desc: Fast pahoehoe: the skin dragged into tight parallel ropes by the flow under it.

specials.name: Cinder: Ember Bed
specials.desc: What is left when the flame goes: a bed that is all heat and no light, breathing where air reaches it.

specials.name: Cinder: Ash Fall
specials.desc: Fine grey settling out of the air and building up wherever the wind lets it.

specials.name: Cinder: Soot Bloom
specials.desc: Carbon inception: dendrites branching out of nothing, the deadest material in the catalog.

specials.name: Cinder: Char Scale
specials.desc: Burnt skin gone to alligator scale, every plate lifted a little at its edge.

specials.name: Cinder: Cinder Lattice
specials.desc: The connected skeleton that survived — only the paths that stayed lit are still there.

specials.name: Cinder: Fly Ash
specials.desc: Spent particles too light to fall, drifting until they cool to nothing.

specials.name: Cinder: Coke Cell
specials.desc: Coal cooked without air until only the carbon cell wall is left standing.

specials.name: Cinder: Clinker Crust
specials.desc: Fused ash that went hard and vitreous in the grate — the stuff you have to break out.

specials.name: Cinder: Ash Glaze
specials.desc: Wood ash melted onto the pot by its own kiln and crazed as it cooled.

specials.name: Cinder: Dying Coal
specials.desc: The last of the heat retreating into the middle of each lump.

specials.name: Cinder: Grey Front
specials.desc: Ash advancing over ember — the moment a fire stops being orange.

specials.name: Cinder: Retained Heat
specials.desc: Cold on the outside, still dangerous in the core; convection barely moving above it.

specials.name: Cinder: Powder Burn
specials.desc: Residue of a fast burn: scorched powder with a few grains that never went off.

specials.name: Cinder: Spall Field
specials.desc: Thermal shock popping flakes off the surface, each leaving a paler crater.

specials.name: Cinder: Cold Ash
specials.desc: Completely out. Fine grey powder holding the shape of what it used to be.

specials.name: Ladle Pour
specials.desc: A pour that froze while it was still moving: laminar tongues under a wrinkled chill skin.

specials.name: Furnace Slag
specials.desc: Gas vesicles frozen mid-rise in a glassy crust, the way slag comes off the top of a heat.

specials.name: Sand Cast
specials.desc: The pebbled face a sand mould leaves, parting line still showing across it.

specials.name: Chill Ingot
specials.desc: Chill bands across the face of an ingot with the shrink pipe drawn down its middle.

specials.name: Forge Scale
specials.desc: Black scale lifting off hot iron, every flake curling at its edge.

specials.name: Planished
specials.desc: Planished by hand: overlapping hammer facets, each one a shallow dish.

specials.name: Damascus Fold
specials.desc: Hundreds of folded layers ground back, the ladder showing where the billet was cut.

specials.name: Face Mill
specials.desc: Overlapping cutter arcs, each pass stepping across the last.

specials.name: Lathe Turn
specials.desc: Concentric feed grooves running out from a chuck set off the panel.

specials.name: Diamond Knurl
specials.desc: The knurling wheel pressed a cross-hatch of pyramids into the bar.

specials.name: Belt Grind
specials.desc: Long parallel scratches with the odd deep one where a torn grit dug in.

specials.name: Weld Bead
specials.desc: Stacked passes of frozen ripple with the heat-affected zone tempering out either side.

specials.name: Plasma Cut
specials.desc: Drag lines raked down the kerf with dross still hanging off the bottom.

specials.name: Zinc Spangle
specials.desc: Hot-dip galvanising froze into big spangle crystals, every facet catching light its own way.

specials.name: Crucible Dross
specials.desc: The oxide skin pulled off the top of a melt, wrinkled and torn where the rod dragged.

specials.name: Cast Spatter
specials.desc: Droplets that flew, landed and froze where they hit, each flattened into its own splat.

specials.name: Teeming Stream
specials.desc: Metal falling from the ladle, drawn into ropes that thin as they stretch.

specials.name: Chill Shot
specials.desc: Atomised metal quenched into beads and packed into a bed.

specials.name: Bloom Iron
specials.desc: A sponge of metal and slag hammered together while it was never quite molten.

specials.name: Tuyere Burn
specials.desc: Where the blast hit, the metal ran and the refractory glazed into downwind streaks.

specials.name: Peened
specials.desc: A thousand overlapping hammer pits, the face work-hardened and dimpled all over.

specials.name: Anvil Face
specials.desc: Worn hollow in the middle and scarred by everything ever beaten on it.

specials.name: Drawn Taper
specials.desc: Stretched under the hammer, so the flats step narrower along the bar.

specials.name: Upset Bulge
specials.desc: Driven back on itself until it swelled, the metal folding in rings around the swell.

specials.name: Swage Block
specials.desc: Hammered down into a shaped die, carrying the die's flutes end to end.

specials.name: Fullered
specials.desc: The fuller drove a row of grooves across the stock to move metal sideways.

specials.name: Quench Check
specials.desc: Cooled too fast: the skin let go in a net of fine checks with hard metal between.

specials.name: Wire EDM
specials.desc: A field of microscopic craters, each one a single spark's worth of metal gone.

specials.name: Honed Bore
specials.desc: The cross-hatch a hone leaves so the oil has somewhere to sit.

specials.name: Broached
specials.desc: Every tooth cut a shade deeper than the last, so the wall steps in fine terraces.

specials.name: Shot Peened
specials.desc: Blasted with steel shot until the face is a mat of overlapping dimples.

specials.name: Cut Thread
specials.desc: A single helix down the bar with the tool's flank marks still in the flanks.

specials.name: Fly Cut
specials.desc: One tool tip swinging a wide arc, leaving the big scallops a surfacing cut is prized for.

specials.name: TIG Stack
specials.desc: Stacked dimes: every dip of the rod froze as its own overlapping disc.

specials.name: MIG Spatter
specials.desc: A fast hot bead with the spatter it threw stuck fast either side.

specials.name: Oxy Cut
specials.desc: Coarse drag lines with the slag that ran down them still welded on.

specials.name: Stitch Weld
specials.desc: Short runs with cold gaps between them, the way thin panel gets joined.

specials.name: Tack Row
specials.desc: A row of spot welds holding the job while the real welding waits.

specials.name: Undercut
specials.desc: The arc ate into the parent plate beside the bead and left a groove no inspector passes.

specials.name: Arc Strike
specials.desc: Where the rod touched off the joint and burned a bright scar into the plate.

specials.name: HAZ Bloom
specials.desc: No mark at all, just the temper colour blooming out from where the heat went in.

specials.name: Anodised
specials.desc: The etch left a fine directional grain and the dye sank into the pore structure.

specials.name: Rust Blued
specials.desc: Cards of black oxide grown, boiled and carded back until the steel went blue-black.

specials.name: Parkerised
specials.desc: A phosphate crystal coat, matt and grey and thirsty for oil.

specials.name: Copper Patina
specials.desc: The green climbing out of the low ground and eating its way across the metal.

specials.name: Powder Coat
specials.desc: The film flowed out but not quite flat, so it kept its orange-peel.

specials.name: Chrome Flash
specials.desc: Flash chrome over a substrate never quite polished out, mirroring every wave under it.

specials.name: Passivated
specials.desc: No coating to see — just the faint mottle the acid left behind.

specials.name: Mill Scale
specials.desc: Hot-rolled scale, blue-black and tight in places, flaked to bare steel in others.

specials.name: Phosphated
specials.desc: A heavy dark etch that bites deepest wherever the grain of the steel runs.

specials.name: Penrose Reliquary
specials.desc: Aperiodic five-fold rhombs that never repeat, leaded in jewel blues and violets.

specials.name: Ammann Vault
specials.desc: Eight-fold aperiodic squares and rhombs drawn in amber and teal behind brass came.

specials.name: Dodeca Choir
specials.desc: Twelve-fold quasiperiodic panes under an iridised film, hairline-leaded.

specials.name: Hex Apiary
specials.desc: A honeycomb of rolled amber glass in copper foil, every cell its own shade.

specials.name: Cairo Lantern
specials.desc: Interlocking pentagons in seedy lantern glass, bubbles caught in every pane.

specials.name: Rhombille Cube
specials.desc: Three rhombi to a hexagon: a floor of tumbling cubes that will not sit still.

specials.name: Lloyd Froth
specials.desc: Relaxed cells of near-equal size, like soap froth frozen and leaded in place.

specials.name: Gilbert Shatter
specials.desc: Cracks that nucleate, run both ways and stop where they meet an older crack.

specials.name: Truchet Braid
specials.desc: Triangular Truchet arcs braiding across the panel behind bevelled came.

specials.name: Wang Current
specials.desc: Edge-matched tiles whose colour runs continue clean across the whole panel.

specials.name: Girih Strap
specials.desc: Five-fold strapwork interlacing over glass cut to every polygon it leaves.

specials.name: Herringbone Hall
specials.desc: Planks of drawn glass laid herringbone and reinforced with wire.

specials.name: Shear Arcade
specials.desc: A leaded lattice that leans further with every course, like a hall seen at speed.

specials.name: Kagome Basket
specials.desc: The trihexagonal basket lattice: triangles and hexagons sharing every vertex.

specials.name: Snub Carousel
specials.desc: Squares pinwheeling between pairs of triangles, every cell twisted against its neighbour.

specials.name: Octagon Court
specials.desc: Broad octagons with a small square dropped into every crossing.

specials.name: Basket Weave
specials.desc: Pairs of planks crossing over and under in fours, foiled at every join.

specials.name: Triangle Choir
specials.desc: The plain equilateral net, every triangle slumped to its own thickness.

specials.name: Pinwheel Infinite
specials.desc: Conway's right triangles at one-to-two: subdivide, turn, repeat — no two panes point the same way.

specials.name: Sphinx March
specials.desc: The sphinx hexiamond, five triangles to a tile, marching by reflex substitution.

specials.name: Chair Recursion
specials.desc: L-trominoes that subdivide into four smaller chairs, and those into four more.

specials.name: Mondrian Cut
specials.desc: A guillotine cut every time: rectangles of every proportion, none of them lining up.

specials.name: Slat Stretch
specials.desc: Voronoi cells drawn out along one axis until they read as rolled slats.

specials.name: Delaunay Web
specials.desc: The triangulation of a scattered point set — every pane a triangle, no two alike.

specials.name: Bubble Raft
specials.desc: Hexagonal close packing with the dislocations a real raft always has.

specials.name: Mudcrack Pan
specials.desc: Mud dried until it split: stubby cells, every join meeting at ninety degrees.

specials.name: Crazed Glaze
specials.desc: The shrinkage net an old glaze crazes into, long cracks first and short ones after.

specials.name: Basalt Column
specials.desc: Columnar basalt in section: hexagons that cooled imperfectly and wander at the joints.

specials.name: Cafe Wall
specials.desc: Straight courses the eye insists are wedges, because every row is offset against the last.

specials.name: Zigzag Ribbon
specials.desc: Courses that fold back on themselves, chevroning all the way down the panel.

specials.name: Spiral Nave
specials.desc: Courses winding out from a pole set off the panel, so the leadwork sweeps instead of rings.

specials.name: Conformal Bend
specials.desc: A square lattice pushed through a conformal map: right angles kept, the grid itself bent.

specials.name: Moire Beat
specials.desc: Two grids at a hair of an angle: where they beat, the panes shrink to slivers.

specials.name: Zellige Star
specials.desc: The eight-point star and its cross, cut and set by hand.

specials.name: Mashrabiya Screen
specials.desc: A turned-wood screen: discs on a lattice joined by bridges, light coming through the rest.

specials.name: Muqarnas Vault
specials.desc: Stepped niches corbelling inward, every tier smaller than the one it hangs from.

specials.name: Woven Interlace
specials.desc: Every strand passes above one neighbour and below the next; the crossings are their own panes.

specials.name: Scalemail Coat
specials.desc: Riveted scale armour, each disc hiding the top of the scale below it.

specials.name: Fishscale Roof
specials.desc: Imbricated arcs — the oldest roofing pattern there is.

specials.name: Droste Well
specials.desc: The same lattice nested inside itself at every octave, opening into a smaller copy of itself.

specials.name: Fibonacci Course
specials.desc: Two plank widths laid in the golden order, so the courses never settle into a repeat.

specials.name: Laguerre Press
specials.desc: Voronoi with weights: big cells shoulder the small ones aside and the joins go crooked.

specials.name: Kite and Dart
specials.desc: Penrose kites and darts: the same pentagrid, offset to the singular value that splits them.

specials.name: Sevenfold Drift
specials.desc: Seven-fold order the plane cannot hold periodically, so the panes drift forever.

specials.name: Flemish Bond
specials.desc: A header and a stretcher alternating in every course — the bond that reads hand-laid.

specials.name: Jali Pierce
specials.desc: Pierced stone: an interlocking net of hexagonal openings inside a hexagonal frame.

specials.name: Hexstar Lantern
specials.desc: Six-point stars with the triangles they leave between them.

specials.name: Elongated Course
specials.desc: Rows of squares alternating with rows of triangles — two kinds of course in one wall.

specials.name: Impact Shatter
specials.desc: Radial fractures from strikes set off the panel, crossed by the rings each strike sent out.

specials.name: Athanor Slag
specials.desc: The glass that froze in the furnace mouth, gas vesicles caught mid-rise along a flow still moving. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Sulfur Crust
specials.desc: Botryoidal sulfur: spheroids budded on spheroids, needles sublimed out of the gaps between. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Herbarium Press
specials.desc: A specimen flattened onto rag paper a century ago: midrib, secondaries, reticulation, foxing. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Transmutation Seal
specials.desc: Concentric bands of ring text with the figure struck across them, cut sharp into the plate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Verdigris Bloom
specials.desc: Copper corrosion spreading as colonies, each a crusted disc that grew until it met the next. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Apothecary Crust
specials.desc: A bottle left to evaporate: every level it stopped at is a ring, and the salt crystallised on each. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Vitriol Etch
specials.desc: Acid on metal: pits that ate outward along the grain, each fringed by the dendrites the reaction left. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Quicksilver
specials.desc: Beads that ran together and stopped: fat lenses joined by necks, tarnish creeping over the stillest. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Philosopher's Stone
specials.desc: The impossible packing: discs of every size nested into the gaps of the discs before them, each cut as a gem. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Cinnabar Druse
specials.desc: A vug lined with crystal: every termination a facetted point, all crowded into the same small space. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Blood Augury
specials.desc: A poured offering dried to a crackle glaze: the network of cracks is the reading. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Planchette Path
specials.desc: A spirit board worn by decades of travel, the letter blocks still there under the arcs the planchette polished. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Casting Bones
specials.desc: Knucklebones thrown and settled where they fell, packed tight, each knobbed at both ends. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Tasseomancy
specials.desc: Leaf fragments left in the cup, settled into the bands the last swirl of tea drew them into. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Palm Reading
specials.desc: Friction ridges flowing around the loops they grew into, broken where the major lines cross. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Astrolabe Plate
specials.desc: Almucantar arcs and azimuth rays engraved into brass, a star pointer punched at the crossings. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Ceromancy
specials.desc: Molten wax dropped into cold water, set as thin lobed sheets, holed and rimmed where it tore. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Black Mirror
specials.desc: A scrying glass knapped from obsidian, conchoidal shells rippling from every strike. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Ink Scrying
specials.desc: A drop of ink opening in water: sheets of filament pulled into each other, thinning to smoke. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Haruspex
specials.desc: The reading surface itself: lobes divided by their fissures, the vessel tree branching across every one. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Urn Slip
specials.desc: A burnished funerary pot: the pebble tool left its strokes, the kiln left its clouds. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Bog Body
specials.desc: Skin tanned by peat acid, the pore field still there, the whole hide creased where the bog folded it. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Coffin Varnish
specials.desc: Shellac gone alligator, hard plates of finish curling off the grain that still shows underneath. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Grave Wax
specials.desc: Adipocere: soft lobes set into each other, every surface crazed by a wax that dried too slowly. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Shroud
specials.desc: Loose linen with threads pulled out of it and the bloom of what soaked through. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Barrow Soil
specials.desc: The matrix an excavation comes out of: grit, root threads and the sherd edges that make the dig worth digging. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Bone Ash
specials.desc: Calcined to a crust, grains sintered into each other with the voids the burning left between. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Barrow Frost
specials.desc: Hoar crystals feathering off cold stone: a spine, side branches, and branches off those. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Ossuary Wall
specials.desc: Long bones stacked end out, packed with the small pieces that fill the gaps, every shaft showing its marrow void. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Corpse Candle
specials.desc: Tallow run down in curtains and set, wick soot blackening the runs it poured over. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Wendigo Horn
specials.desc: Keratin laid down in growth laminae around a curved core, split lengthwise where it dried. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Thunderbird Quill
specials.desc: Barbs combed off a storm-bird shaft, zipped by barbules and torn open where the vane parted. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Mothman Dust
specials.desc: Wing scales shingled in rows, each a ribbed paddle that comes off on your fingers. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Lake Serpent Scute
specials.desc: Keeled belly plates carrying the growth annuli of every year it swam, under a haze of shed skin. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Devil's Hoof
specials.desc: Horn wall in laminae, packed with the tubules that grew it, split down the cleft. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Sasquatch Pelt
specials.desc: Guard hair matted into locks, every lock combed by the same weather and clumped where it dried. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Chupacabra Spine
specials.desc: Dorsal spikes in ranks with the membrane still stretched between them, veined and torn. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Grendel Hide
specials.desc: Thick leather gone to warts, nodules of every size bedded in a cracked matrix and seamed where old wounds closed. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Kraken Sucker
specials.desc: Rings of chitin teeth packed down the arm, each cup a ring of dentition around a dark throat. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Deep One Gill
specials.desc: Lamellae stacked plate on plate in curved ranks, every filament combed by the water it last breathed. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Hexfoil Ward
specials.desc: Compass-scribed daisy wheels burned into a threshold beam to turn a witch back at the door. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Witch Bottle
specials.desc: Bent nails, pins and hair packed into buried glass to catch a curse before it reaches the house. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Binding Knot
specials.desc: An endless knot tied over and under itself so that whatever it holds can never be untied. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Coffin Nail Ward
specials.desc: Coffin nails driven in a ward grid, each head ringed by the bruise its hammer left in the plate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Salt Circle
specials.desc: A poured salt line dried to a crust, throwing dendrites off every edge across black slate. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Poppet Stitch
specials.desc: Sackcloth closed with crossed sutures and studded with the pins pushed through the poppet. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Hag Stone
specials.desc: Flint bored through by water, hung on a nail so the eye it grew can watch the door. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Sigil Seal
specials.desc: Oxblood wax struck with a sigil die, every disc sagging into the skirt it cooled in. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Red Thread Cross
specials.desc: Crimson yarn wound over crossed rowan twigs, the ply twist running against the wind. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.

specials.name: Iron Cage
specials.desc: Riveted strap iron crossed over a void, forge scale still flaking from the bars. A FRACTURED RELICS finish.
