specials.name: Ryokucha Scroll
specials.desc: Dark green tea-lacquer scrollwork with emerald flake pockets and carved metallic currents.

specials.name: Mikan Pearl
specials.desc: Mikan orange pearl fade with coral-gold shimmer, soft flake texture, and warm candy depth.

specials.name: Azure Celestial
specials.desc: Cobalt-and-silver imperial dragon brocade — sky dragons, clouds and scales in gold linework; spec traced from the art for a shimmering scale-and-cloud reveal.

specials.name: Vermilion Fire
specials.desc: Crimson-and-gold dragon brocade with curling flame fields; the fire motifs trace into glossy cut-outs that breathe under sun.

specials.name: Abyssal Sea
specials.desc: Jade-and-aqua sea-dragon brocade with foam crests; wave and scale motifs gate the angle reveal.

specials.name: Imperial Gold
specials.desc: Radiant gold-on-lacquer dragon-scale damask; gold linework reads as metal, lacquer cells as glossy clearcoat.

specials.name: Storm Black
specials.desc: Black-and-silver storm-dragon brocade with lightning forks; moody dark ground laced with electric metal veins.

specials.name: Jade Empress
specials.desc: Carved-jade dragon brocade — translucent greens with white relief and gold; sculpted scale field.

specials.name: Frost Emperor
specials.desc: Ice-white and glacier-blue dragon brocade with snowflake and frost-fern motifs; crisp cool reveal.

specials.name: Bronze Relic
specials.desc: Antique bronze and verdigris dragon-coin brocade; aged-treasure patina with gold-leaf relief.

specials.name: Pearl Chaser
specials.desc: Red-and-gold dragons chasing flaming pearls; the pearls trace into glowing focal gems scattered across the body.

specials.name: Dragon & Phoenix
specials.desc: Interlocking dragon-and-phoenix medallion brocade in cobalt, crimson and gold; balanced duo reveal.

specials.name: Phoenix Fenghuang
specials.desc: Crimson-orange-and-teal phoenix brocade — sweeping eye-spot tail-feathers fanning every direction; gold linework on a dark ground.

specials.name: Jade Qilin
specials.desc: Jade-and-gold qilin brocade — scaled unicorn-beasts and cloud scrolls in all orientations; auspicious omnidirectional weave.

specials.name: Guardian Foo Lion
specials.desc: Imperial-red-and-gold temple-lion brocade — curly-maned foo dogs with coins and knots; ivory highlights flash as pearl.

specials.name: Vermilion Bird
specials.desc: Vermilion-and-flame-gold southern-phoenix brocade with ember motifs; fiery birds turning every way under sun.

specials.name: Black Tortoise
specials.desc: Black-jade-and-silver Xuanwu brocade — tortoise shells and serpents with water scrolls; deep moody ground.

specials.name: White Tiger Baihu
specials.desc: White-silver-and-gold Bai Hu brocade — black-striped tigers prowling all directions with wind curls and coins.

specials.name: Crane Garden
specials.desc: Pale-jade crane-garden brocade — red-crowned cranes, pine, lotus and peony; light airy ground for a softer reveal.

specials.name: Koi Ascension
specials.desc: Cobalt-and-gold koi brocade — orange-and-white carp swimming every way over foam swirls and coins.

specials.name: Pixiu Fortune
specials.desc: Antique-gold-and-jade Pixiu brocade — winged wealth-beasts amid coin showers; gold reads as metal, jade as gloss.

specials.name: Golden Toad Jinchan
specials.desc: Gold-on-lucky-red money-toad brocade — three-legged Jin Chan with coin strings and lotus; opulent prosperity weave.

specials.name: Old Glory Flux
specials.desc: Deep navy lacquer dusted with red-and-white star-flecks under a multi-directional color-shift sheen that travels red-white-blue as the car turns.

specials.name: Rockets Red Glare
specials.desc: Firework bursts of concentric red and gold rings on a near-black night field — the sparks flare mirror-bright only when light rakes the panel.

specials.name: Liberty Torch
specials.desc: Omnidirectional licking flame tongues in red, orange and gold over ember-black — wrapped torch heat that glows hotter at the tips in clearcoat.

specials.name: Eagle Ascendant
specials.desc: Dense gold-on-navy brocade of scattered feather and wing motifs at every angle — imperial eagle damask that catches gilt light from any direction.

specials.name: We The People
specials.desc: Aged parchment cross-hatched with an engraved banknote guilloche — debossed ink lines in every direction with a low scholarly sheen.

specials.name: Midnight Militia
specials.desc: Tactical matte multicam in muted navy, slate and olive blotches with fine deep grain — dead-flat, light-eating stealth patriot camo.

specials.name: Freedom Forge
specials.desc: Molten steel mid-pour — glowing orange cracks web across cooling gunmetal cells with white-hot sparks, the cracks blazing in clearcoat.

specials.name: Amber Waves
specials.desc: Rippling wheat-gold grain bending under crossing winds — soft sheen-corridors roll across the gold like sun on a prairie.

specials.name: Glory Chrome
specials.desc: Liquid show-chrome brushed in crossing directions and dusted with red, white and blue mirror flecks — a polished patriot mirror.

specials.name: Sparkler Dusk
specials.desc: Dusk-purple twilight scattered with comet-spark micro-flake — tapered spark streaks at every angle, each tipped with a twinkling white-hot flake.

specials.name: Ember Glass
specials.desc: Blood-orange candy laid over coarse silver flake, shattered by a crackle relief: the coat burns thin and fiery on every plateau and pools deep crimson-black in the crack valleys. Under track lights the crack web glows wet while flake glints spark across the faces.

specials.name: Glacier Core
specials.desc: Crushed-ice facets locked under arctic cyan candy: every angular shard tips its own way, the coat staying thin and bright on the faces while the fissures between shards flood deep sapphire. Edge glints flash along the shard lines like sun on broken ice.

specials.name: Abyss Lantern
specials.desc: A near-black deep-sea teal so thick the metal barely survives the dive - until light rakes across it and hidden lantern cells bloom out of the clearcoat like bioluminescence. Head-on it is abyss; at an angle the car is alive.

specials.name: Stained Aurora
specials.desc: A leaded stained-glass window poured over silver leaf: every flow-warped pane is its own jewel - ruby, amber, emerald, sapphire, violet - in deep candy glass that pools darker toward its lead border. Hand-rolled ripple catches the light inside each pane.

specials.name: Prism Veil
specials.desc: Banded thin-film interference orders drift like a torn veil over a near-black cherry base - amber, magenta and violet plateaus split by prismatic shimmer, with the order edges flaring under direct light.

specials.name: Oilforge
specials.desc: Oil-slick rings bloom in quantized Newton bands around scattered heat spots on brushed gunmetal - the brush grain changes direction patch to patch, and the ring crests flare while the heat centers pool with wet gloss.

specials.name: Tempered Dawn
specials.desc: Titanium weld-temper: straw, bronze, violet and blue heat bands trace curling weld paths across raw brushed metal, and the bead line itself flares like fresh chrome under direct light.

specials.name: Pulse Alloy
specials.desc: Concentric pulses ripple out from scattered impact points, every ring order snapping to a different hue - teal, violet, magenta, gold - before fading into brushed alloy with a soft pooled glow.

specials.name: Velvet Eclipse
specials.desc: Deep indigo velvet shot through with a molten-gold micro lattice — head-on it reads midnight, raking sun sets the gold pools on fire while eclipse coronas glow in the clearcoat.

specials.name: Wovenlight
specials.desc: An over/under ribbon weave of emerald satin and royal-violet mirror that flips color as the car turns — dive shadows give the basket real depth and light pools diagonally across the weave.

specials.name: Sovereign Flip
specials.desc: Three paints in one: matte oxblood, mirror champagne and glass-deep emerald candy split the body into fine inked territories — every sun angle shows you a different car.

specials.name: Static Bloom
specials.desc: Electric-cobalt micro-static, magenta filament streaks and amber soft blooms each claim their own territory, their own hue family and their own light behavior — a triple-personality finish.

specials.name: Aurora Travel
specials.desc: An aurora curtain that physically travels: glossy corridors cut across the teal-violet-magenta flow, so the live highlight slides through different hues as the car rotates, while curtain-edge filaments flare icy white under direct light.

specials.name: Saffron Circuit
specials.desc: Etched micro-circuitry in saffron, rose and ember: trace density steers the hue, the grooves polish glossy and pool dark candy, and every via dot glows wet under the clear.

specials.name: Quicksilver Garden
specials.desc: Liquid chrome overgrown with a garden of pastel cells — every cell grows its own mini color ramp in its own direction behind a mirror-bright rim, and each cell flares at its own angle as you drive.

specials.name: Emberline Drift
specials.desc: Folded dune ridges drift from gold through crimson into smoke; satin sheen lanes cross the dunes at their own angles while embers pool and glow in the clearcoat between the crests.

specials.name: Duomorph
specials.desc: Two hidden artworks on one car: orbital glyph rosettes flare in the metallic under direct sun, while sweeping ribbon arcs glow out of the clearcoat at glancing angles — the deep graphite paint only whispers both until the light picks a side.

specials.name: Nightbloom
specials.desc: Dusk indigo melting into plum, seeded from scattered night-sky anchors — and when low sun rakes the clearcoat, luminous petal-fan blooms open across the car that the paint itself only hints at.

specials.name: Magnetite Flow
specials.desc: Ferrofluid spike colonies frozen mid-pulse on wet black: the coat pools deep blue-black between the spikes and thins to bright steel at every crest, and only the spike tips spark when the sun hits them dead-on.

specials.name: Comet Parade
specials.desc: A deep-space violet-to-teal field crossed by three separate comet swarms — heads spark in direct light, long wakes drag bright and dark gloss lanes across the panels, and bow-shock crescents glow out of the clearcoat at low sun.

specials.name: CX Burgundy-Wine-Gold

specials.name: CX Northern Lights

specials.name: CX Peacock Fan

specials.name: CX Rainbow Stealth

specials.name: CX Oil Slick
specials.desc: 5-shade: magenta → violet → blue → teal → green. Gasoline on water, metallic.

specials.name: CX Molten Metal
specials.desc: 5-shade: black → red → orange → gold → white. Forge-hot at micro scale.

specials.name: CX Red-Green Impossible

specials.name: CX Orange-Blue Electric
specials.desc: Complementary shock. Warm orange and cool blue at pixel level. Electric tension.

specials.name: CX Pink-Yellow Pop
specials.desc: Bubblegum meets sunshine. Hot pink and bright yellow at flake scale — surprisingly elegant.

specials.name: CX Purple-Gold Majesty
specials.desc: Deep purple and rich gold in noble opposition. LSU. Lakers. Royalty.

specials.name: CX Prism Reactor Shift

specials.name: CX Pink Gold Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Hot pink and rich gold trade dominance through abstract liquid islands across the whole canvas. No stripes, no single candy-band roll.

specials.name: CX Blue Orange Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Cobalt and ember roll back and forth in broken abstract currents, giving several color-shift reversals instead of one hard split.

specials.name: CX Purple Green Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Royal purple and electric green alternate through abstract jewel pools and contour eddies with lively spec-map contrast.

specials.name: CX Teal Magenta Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Teal and magenta pulse through abstract plasma eddies with several back-and-forth reversals across the panel.

specials.name: CX Red Cyan Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Fire red and ice cyan snap through abstract cellular wakes instead of stripe rails or candy-cane bands.

specials.name: CX Sunset Shift
specials.desc: Broad warm-to-cool sweep tuned like late sun falling into plum shadow. Softer and more atmospheric than the aggressive duo flips.

specials.name: CX Emerald → Ruby Shift

specials.name: CX Ice Fire Abstract Shift
specials.desc: Frozen blue and ember orange chase each other through abstract thermal islands with lively, varied spec channels.

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Red/Blue

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Pink/Black

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Orange/Cyan

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Lime/Purple

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Purple/Gold

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Electric Blue/Copper

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Bronze/Teal

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Silver/Violet

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Crimson Prism

specials.name: CX HyperFlip Midnight Opal

specials.name: CX Forest Fire

specials.name: CX Deep Sea

specials.name: CX Autumn Blaze

specials.name: GL 00 Control (Ghost Fracture)
specials.desc: GL 00 Control (Ghost Fracture) — GHOST LAB experiment — Byte-identical Ghost Fracture. Your reference — everything else changes ONE thing vs this. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 01 Metal LOW (~150)
specials.desc: GL 01 Metal LOW (~150) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 1 TEST: metal dropped to the level our newer finishes use. If the purple stops jumping through, near-max metal is the body-color engine. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 02 Metal MID (~185)
specials.desc: GL 02 Metal MID (~185) — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 1 dose-response: halfway. Tells us the metal threshold where color-jump starts dying. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 03 Rough PASTEL (150-200)
specials.desc: GL 03 Rough PASTEL (150-200) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 2 TEST + the pastel doctrine on-track: roughness raised to the light-pastel band. If flashes go soft/hazy, low roughness is what makes them EXPLODE. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 04 Rough MIRROR (30-60)
specials.desc: GL 04 Rough MIRROR (30-60) — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 2 the other direction: glossier than GF. Do flashes get even sharper/harder? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 05 Clearcoat FLAT (no cells)
specials.desc: GL 05 Clearcoat FLAT (no cells) — GHOST LAB experiment — PILLAR 3 TEST: same metal+gloss but the carve is GONE (CC uniform 212). If gold still flashes but with no cell pattern, the carve is only the SHAPE; if gold dies, the carve is the engine. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 06 Clearcoat SHALLOW carve
specials.desc: GL 06 Clearcoat SHALLOW carve — GHOST LAB experiment — Pillar 3 dose-response: carve amplitude halved. How much swing does the two-color travel need? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 07 Clearcoat INVERTED
specials.desc: GL 07 Clearcoat INVERTED — GHOST LAB experiment — Cells swap polarity (carved becomes flooded). Should swap WHERE gold vs teal appears — confirms the cells choose which env color shows. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 08 Cells MICRO (3x smaller)
specials.desc: GL 08 Cells MICRO (3x smaller) — GHOST LAB experiment — Structure scale: same recipe, 3x finer cells. Does fine structure shimmer instead of detonate? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 09 Cells MACRO (3x bigger)
specials.desc: GL 09 Cells MACRO (3x bigger) — GHOST LAB experiment — Structure scale: 3x bigger cells. Do big panels flash harder but read blocky? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 10 Full PASTEL recipe
specials.desc: GL 10 Full PASTEL recipe — GHOST LAB experiment — The round-5 pastel doctrine applied to GF geometry (rough 150-170, compressed carve 191-240). Head-to-head vs GL 00 settles whether pastel beats the original on track. Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: GL 11 Clearcoat MAX carve
specials.desc: GL 11 Clearcoat MAX carve — GHOST LAB experiment — Carve amplitude pushed to the rails (cells swing 40<->250). Is more swing more magic, or does it clip into noise? Ritual: assign as BASE, set the SAME purple, CRUSH brightness, same daytime track, compare to GL 00.

specials.name: Basalt Columns
specials.desc: Basalt Columns — FRACTURED MINDS color-shift base — Giant's Causeway columns end-on: hot and cold column clans, chipped sparkling rims, and onion-fracture rings giving every column its own radial flash signature. Assign as BASE, pick a color, CRUSH the brightness near black, daytime track.

specials.name: Tsunami
specials.desc: Tsunami — FRACTURED MINDS color-shift base — assign as BASE, pick a color, CRUSH the brightness near black, daytime track: the carved cells flash sky-teal and sun-gold by angle while flakes and slashes fire from inside the pattern.

specials.name: Mudcrack Curl

specials.name: Penrose Quasi
specials.desc: Penrose Quasi — FRACTURED MINDS color-shift base — five-fold quasicrystal interference that NEVER repeats anywhere on the car: gold star suns, cyan anti-star wells, and an aperiodic mirror flood across the low field. Assign as BASE, pick a color, CRUSH the brightness near black, daytime track.

specials.name: Prism Pool

specials.name: Rainbow River
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Rainbow River: Spectrum as a fluid: hue advected along real currents — rainbow streams, eddies trapping whirlpools of trapped color.

specials.name: Redshift Drift
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Redshift Drift: Receding galaxies: streaks red-shifted trailing, blue-shifted leading, smeared along the expansion flow.

specials.name: Shatter Glass
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Shatter Glass: Tempered glass exploded: shard mosaic, each fragment refracting its own dispersion gradient, prism fringes at every fracture line.

specials.name: Singularity Lens
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Singularity Lens: A deep-field sky gravitationally smeared into Einstein arcs and rings around invisible dark masses, violet rim-light on the voids.

specials.name: Smectic Fan
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Smectic Fan: Smectic focal-conic fans: packed ribbed fan domains, each refracting its own slice of the wheel — polarized-microscope money shot.

specials.name: Smoke Chroma
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Smoke Chroma: Laminar smoke going turbulent, every filament carrying its slice of spectrum through the curl.

specials.name: Spill Metropolis
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Spill Metropolis: Gasoline rainbow on wet night asphalt: micro-aggregate, drain swirls, neon signs bleeding into the slick.

specials.name: Star Temperature
specials.desc: ★ Spectrum Shift — Star Temperature: The HR diagram as a sky: thousands of stars each colored by its real temperature class — red dwarfs to blue giants.

specials.name: Topo Rainbow

specials.name: OKLab Flow Gradient
specials.desc: A perceptual OKLab sunset ramp drifting along a curl-noise flow — organic, never a dead-straight band. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Iridescent Gradient
specials.desc: Oil-slick holographic hue travelling the spectrum along a warped radial coordinate with thin-film sheen — iridescent metal film. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Ridged Contour Gradient
specials.desc: A warped deep-sea ramp quantised into smooth topographic contour bands with bright ridge-lines — a designed banded surface. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Mesh Bleed Gradient
specials.desc: Several aurora colour sources bleeding into each other so colour pools and flows — a multi-source gradient mesh. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Duotone Grain Gradient
specials.desc: A candy-chrome two-anchor OKLab ramp broken by fine ordered dither-grain so the transition shimmers with premium micro-texture. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Chromatic Aberration Gradient
specials.desc: The same warped miami ramp sampled at three per-channel offsets so R/G/B diverge into prismatic colour fringing — lens-edge chromatic aberration. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Spectral Sweep Gradient
specials.desc: A full-spectrum rainbow sweeping once along a warped diagonal, OKLab-smooth so the hues stay clean — a single flowing rainbow band. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Liquid Marble Gradient
specials.desc: Iteratively domain-warped royal-purple veins folded into stirred-paint marbling, read off a multi-hue OKLab ramp. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Moire Interference Gradient
specials.desc: Two crossed near-orthogonal wave fields beating into shimmering chrome-ice interference bands — a woven optical gradient. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Holo Foil Gradient
specials.desc: Fine repeated diagonal rainbow strips with a crossing sheen band — a holographic foil catching light. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Radial Burst Gradient
specials.desc: Molten colour swept by angle around a point with a bright radial burst falling off outward — a starburst gradient. A GRADIENTS finish.

specials.name: Hyperprism Supernova
specials.desc: 15-color mirrored prism wedges detonate through spectral shock rings, fine arcs, glints, short sweeps, rings and petal sparks.

specials.name: Aurora Reactor
specials.desc: 14-color reactor curtains drive cyan, emerald, acid-lime, violet and hot-pink aurora energy through a vertically turbulent field.

specials.name: Toxic Candy Nebula
specials.desc: 12-color candy gas clouds collide toxic lime, ultraviolet, hot pink, tangerine and electric cyan inside a warped nebula.

specials.name: Ultraviolet Solarstorm
specials.desc: 13-color solar shockwaves cross ultraviolet, magenta, ember, gold and ion-blue in asymmetric expanding bands.

specials.name: Chromatic Faultline
specials.desc: 15-color tectonic shelves split a complete extreme spectrum along luminous fault traces with crushed fine debris.

specials.name: Kaleidoscope Overdrive
specials.desc: 12-color stained-light cells fracture purple, cobalt, cyan, green, amber and coral into a nonrepeating overdrive mosaic.

specials.name: Spectrum Dragonfire
specials.desc: 14-color braided flame tongues climb from violet through magenta, scarlet, molten gold, cyan and blue-white heat.

specials.name: Digital Acid Rain
specials.desc: 11-color segmented acid rain cascades through black-green, toxic lime, laser yellow, cyan and hard digital blue.

specials.name: Quantum Carnival
specials.desc: 15-color five-axis quasicrystal interference throws the full neon spectrum into impossible carnival symmetry.

specials.name: Holographic Maelstrom
specials.desc: 13-color counter-rotating vortices shear blue, aqua, green, yellow, coral, magenta and violet holographic bands.

specials.name: Electric Coral Rift
specials.desc: 10-color ocean-cyan and electric-coral plates tear apart at a brilliant energized rift with fine local fracture marks.

specials.name: Neon Cathedral
specials.desc: 12-color nested luminous arches rise through violet, magenta, ember, gold, ion-blue and white-hot stained light.

specials.name: Plasma Oilspill
specials.desc: 15-color liquid topology folds cold blue, cyan, emerald, acid yellow, molten orange, pink and ultraviolet like energized oil.

specials.name: Candy Quasar
specials.desc: 11-color candy rays erupt from concentric quasar rings in violet, fuchsia, peach, gold, mint and crystalline blue.

specials.name: Laser Jungle
specials.desc: 13-color bioelectric vines weave jungle green, acid lime, cyan, cobalt, ultraviolet, hot pink and ember laser light.

specials.name: Infrared Glacier
specials.desc: 10-color faceted ice travels from abyssal blue through cyan-white into infrared peach, scarlet and frozen black-red.

specials.name: Prismatic Thunderhead
specials.desc: 14-color branching storm ridges ignite indigo, ultraviolet, magenta, orange, yellow, electric green and lightning blue.

specials.name: Solar Reef
specials.desc: 12-color cellular reef light blooms through ocean blue, turquoise, mint, sun-yellow, coral, hot pink and deep violet.

specials.name: Velvet Spectrum Crash
specials.desc: 15-color torn velvet ribbons slam violet, fuchsia, scarlet, orange, yellow, green, cyan and cobalt into layered color impact.

specials.name: Cosmic Heatmap
specials.desc: 11-color topographic energy terraces climb from midnight and cobalt through cyan, green, yellow, orange and red-hot cosmic peaks.

specials.name: Domain Coloring Singularity
specials.desc: 15-color complex-domain singularities are curl-warped into ionized folds, edged with fine spectral filaments and controlled mineral-neon color geography.

specials.name: Nebulabrot Ionstorm
specials.desc: 14-color orbit-density nebulae collide with spectral-silk interference, forming seeded plasma clouds, charged rims and fine ion channels.

specials.name: Superformula Starforge
specials.desc: 13-color superformula stars are interference-warped into forged petals, nested wave chambers, sharp ridges and glittering micro-arcs.

specials.name: Bismuth Colorquake
specials.desc: 12-color bismuth terraces interlock with Chladni nodal geometry, creating crystalline steps, seismic seams and fine resonant edgework.

specials.name: Stable Ink Supercurrent
specials.desc: 15-color stable-fluid ink is driven through a caustic current, layering turbulent plumes, refractive threads, flecks, rings and luminous wake lines.

specials.name: Electrostatic Candy Wells
specials.desc: 11-color equipotential wells bend across ridged terrain, producing candy-charged basins, fine field contours, spark arcs and high-voltage pinpoints.

specials.name: Ferrofluid Spectrum Crown
specials.desc: 14-color ferrofluid spike crowns mesh with a fine gyroid lattice, stacking magnetic peaks, spectral cells, razor ridges and micro-glints.

specials.name: Viscous Prism Fingers
specials.desc: 13-color viscous fingers refract through a Schlieren field, splitting into prismatic branches, pressure halos, short sweeps and fine capillary veins.

specials.name: Scarab Shingle Cascade
specials.desc: 12-color scarab-scale shingles cascade through caustic light, with fractured color flipping across fine overlapping plates, rims and spectral flecks.

specials.name: Nacre Brickwave
specials.desc: 12-color nacre bricks flow through a Gabor filament weave, building pearl tiles, fine mortar flashes, threadlike waves and opalescent edge shifts.

specials.name: Singularity Loom
specials.desc: 15-color conformal lattice is curl-woven into a singularity loom of pinched cells, fine braided currents, orbit rings and luminous crossing points.

specials.name: Harmonic Cathedral
specials.desc: 14-color harmonograph tracery rises through Chladni resonance, forming cathedral arches, stained spectral chambers, fine ribs and jeweled nodes.

specials.name: Neon Underglow
specials.desc: Ground-effects cyan and magenta rising through smoked wet-look paint. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Midnight Drift
specials.desc: Backlit drift haze, curved skid-light and ember heat moving laterally through black. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Tokyo Rain
specials.desc: Rain-smeared Tokyo sign color reflected through deep wet asphalt clear. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Redline Rush
specials.desc: Escalating redline heat and speed rhythm without a literal gauge. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Quarter Mile
specials.desc: Staging-light energy, fragmented micro-checks and launch streaks on a wet strip. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Nitro Purge
specials.desc: Electric-blue purge plumes, frost shock and white pressure cores. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Boost Spool
specials.desc: Cyan intake pressure winding into orange turbine heat and compressor glints. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Tunnel Vision
specials.desc: Vanishing tunnel lights stretching into yellow, cyan and white speed wedges. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Wet Apex
specials.desc: A luminous racing line cutting an S-curve through rain-dark pavement. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Afterburn Chrome
specials.desc: Heat-shifted chrome with broad spectral oxidation bands and brushed fire. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Grid Runner
specials.desc: Broken perspective grids and hard-turn light trails over a digital void. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Street Pulse
specials.desc: Crossing long-exposure traffic rivers and wet lane reflections. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Carbon Voltage
specials.desc: Edge-lit carbon weave split by charged cyan and violet seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Import Royalty
specials.desc: Layered razor vinyl slashes with prismatic tuner-wrap edges. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Blacklight Garage
specials.desc: Fluorescent solvent pools and ultraviolet shop-light reflections on concrete black. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Burnout Ember
specials.desc: Curved tire-heat tracks, underlit smoke and ember-red rubber fragments. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Split Underglow
specials.desc: Opposed cyan and magenta ground-light fields dividing a smoked body. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Signglass Shatter
specials.desc: Broken sign-glass territories with white-hot rims and dying phosphor interiors. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Seoul Circuit
specials.desc: Rounded luminous panel cascades and mint-lilac city-current seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Laser Lane
specials.desc: Few decisive laser corridors built from tightly bundled fine beams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Arcade Afterhours
specials.desc: Blacklight scan waves, vector sweeps and phosphor trails after closing time. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Toxic Overdrive
specials.desc: Acid-green current pools with yellow pressure lips and black sink regions. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Phantom Taillights
specials.desc: Red and magenta afterimage ribbons fading through midnight blue. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Turbo Heat
specials.desc: Anodized titanium heat zones, weld ripples and hot turbine seams. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Midnight Candy
specials.desc: Deep candy violet with broad cyan-magenta angle-flip shoulders. ★ NEON UNDERGROUND finish.

specials.name: Cel Cloud Sea
specials.desc: A Ghibli sky-sea — stratified cel-shaded cloud decks with ink rims, sun stipple and tiny birds. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Impact Frames
specials.desc: Manga impact-burst cells — jagged spike outlines, B/W flash sectors, halftone interiors, yellow flashes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Hanami Night
specials.desc: Festival night — glowing ribbed paper lanterns on strings, firefly bokeh, branch silhouettes, drifting petals. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Mecha Hologrid
specials.desc: Holographic CAD space — depth-faded grids, wireframe primitives, targeting reticles, scan sweep. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Shuriken Storm
specials.desc: A blade blizzard — concave 4-point shuriken with spin trails, kunai, embed cracks, crimson ribbons. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Raiton Lightning
specials.desc: A dendritic lightning nest — stepped zigzag bolts, white-hot cores in cyan sheaths, mauve echo strikes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Iris Gem Field
specials.desc: A field of anime-eye irises — radial fibers, limbal rings, jewel heterochromia, window catchlights. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Holo Idol Foil
specials.desc: Idol-sticker holo foil — warped rainbow interference, micro-prism facets, star and heart confetti. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Kanji Rain
specials.desc: Columns of brush-stroke glyphs raining down washi — sumi ink, vermillion accents, hanko seals. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Onomatopoeia Riot
specials.desc: A comic sound-effect riot — jagged double-outline bursts, halftone shading, slash marks, action dashes. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Cyber Glitch
specials.desc: Digital dissolve — displaced RGB-split slices, pixel-sort streaks, corrupted neon block mosaics. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Retro Broadcast
specials.desc: A CRT transmission — phosphor triads, scanlines, interlace jitter, ghosting, static bursts, test bars. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Blood Moon Eclipse
specials.desc: A sky multiplied with eclipse moons — cel-banded craters, bright rim arcs, crossing cloud wisps, flocks. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Oni Sumi-e
specials.desc: Demon-mask brushwork — dry-bristle horn and fang strokes, enso rings, ink mist, vermillion hanko. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Manga Page Chaos
specials.desc: An exploded manga spread — recursive panels, ink gutters, every panel a different screentone story. ★ ANIME INSPIRED finish.

specials.name: Diffraction Spiral
specials.desc: A CD/DVD micro-grating spun into a log-spiral that splits white light into a spectral swirl. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Thin-Film Oil Slick
specials.desc: Thin-film interference over a flowing film — oil-on-water iridescence, glossy and shifting. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Refractive Caustics
specials.desc: The bright cyan caustic web focused on a sunlit pool floor, rippling over deep teal water. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Newton's Rings
specials.desc: Scattered lens-contact interference rings (phase proportional to r^2) overlapping into a spectral quilt. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Prism Dispersion
specials.desc: White light shot through scattered prisms, fanning into crossing spectral shafts with fine fingering. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Moire Interference
specials.desc: Warped line-gratings beating into organic full-spectrum moire fringes over a fine line micro-texture. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Aurora Veil
specials.desc: Flowing auroral curtains — luminous draped sheets climbing green to violet with fine ray striations. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Soap-Bubble Froth
specials.desc: A froth of translucent soap bubbles — thin-film spheres with specular glints and bright Fresnel rims. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Fiber-Optic Bundle
specials.desc: A bundle of glowing optical fibres — thin curl-flow strands blazing into bright point tips. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Holographic Foil
specials.desc: Embossed holo-glitter foil — a fine diamond mosaic where each cell flashes its own spectral hue. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Lenticular Flip
specials.desc: A lenticular lens sheet — wavy cylindrical lenslets flipping spectral parallax bands with bright crowns. Light & Optics finish.

specials.name: Carbon Twill Weave
specials.desc: A true 2/2 twill carbon-fibre weave — interlacing tows, diagonal rib, fine carbon filaments. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Forged Carbon
specials.desc: Marbled chopped-carbon composite — flake shards at random fibre angles with micro glints in resin. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Engine-Turned Metal
specials.desc: Machined jeweling — overlapping domed swirls of fine concentric brush rings on polished metal. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Liquid Metal
specials.desc: Flowing chrome / mercury — a reflective metaball surface with mirror bands and capillary ripples. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Crystal Lattice
specials.desc: A grown mineral bed — faceted crystal grains with bright cleavage edges and pin-point glints. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Ferrofluid Spikes
specials.desc: Ferrofluid under a magnet — the Rosensweig spike lattice, black iron mounds with glossy steel caps. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Fracture Net
specials.desc: A stressed brittle surface shattered into a bright crack network over subtly tilted plates. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Damascus Steel
specials.desc: Pattern-welded Damascus — folded layers of light/dark steel ground back into a flowing watermark. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Kevlar Aramid Weave
specials.desc: Golden aramid basket-weave — pairs of tows woven two-at-a-time with fine aramid filaments. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Anodized Titanium
specials.desc: Heat-tinted titanium — straw / violet / cobalt / cyan oxide colours flowing over fine ground metal. Materials & Physics finish.

specials.name: Meteorite Widmanstatten
specials.desc: Etched iron-meteorite — interlocking kamacite ribbons crossing at the octahedrite angles. Materials & Physics finish.
